We praise Thee for Thy mighty grapes, and for Thy long life. The sons of the sacrifice of rain, O fire, said these words to you. Protect them and the demigods who are chanting the six-year-old sacrifice.
Mandala 10.165: Sthaura with fire or Sthaura with fire.Indra Drink the moon for the great senses, and drink it for the killing of Vṛtrāsura, O Śaviṣṭha. Drink the honey offered to the dead body of the king and be satisfied with the bull. Drink this, O Indra, the best of the sons of the moon, who has gone to the moon. They are the source of happiness and the source of all happiness. May the divine moon, Indra, who gives birth to you on earth, be mine. By whom thou hast made boons to me, and by whom thou hast destroyed my enemies. A dvibarha amino yatvindra bull haribhya parishiktamandha. O bull kill the sorrows of the sacrifice with the honey of the cow's son They are not sharp, but they are stable like the sharp ones of the Yatujuna. I give you the strength to be fierce and cut off your enemies from the sword. Vya1rya Indra tanuhi shravansyoja: sthireva dhanvano abhimatiḥ. Increase our body, which is not destroyed by our companions. This is the oblation offered to the Indras for the night of the emperor’s destruction of the vulture. Your son, Indra, is cooked and you are ready to drink. O Indra, offer these sacrifices to the gods, and cook the moon in the yogurt. We will take you to Prayasvanta May the desires of the sacrificer be fulfilled. I will send good words to the fires of Indra, like the sea, and I will send the boats to the suns. The gods who give us wealth and fruit are wandering about like these.
Mandala 10.166: The monk Angirasa. Donation of wealth and food., 1-2 Jagti. Nor did the gods kill hunger, nor did the dead go to the hungry. Therefore the sun does not give the sword to the sword, but the sword does not find the crusher. They’re the ones who’ve been drinking and drinking for the adherents. He whose mind is steady and who serves the former does not find the crusher of the mind. He is the one who gives food to the householder and the lean man who is hungry. Aram becomes his friend when he is invited to the Utaparis. He is not a friend who does not give to his friend Sachabhuve Sachamana. There is no one who is dearer to us than water, and there is no one who desires to die. The path to the lowest of the lowest should be followed by the lowest of the lowest. They are moving like wheels on a chariot and the kings are standing on top of each other. He finds food in vain, and I tell you the truth, it’s his death. The woman who nourishes us is our friend and is the only one who is the only light. The plowman makes the fruit eat, and he cuts the road with his characters. Speaking of the Brahman, he should be able to cover the forests and not cover the woods. He moved from one foot to two feet, then from two feet to three feet. He stood in a row looking at the four-legged animals in the same voice as the two-legged animals. The same hands are not equally inserted, and the same mother is not equally milked. They are not equal in strength to the Yamas and are not equal to the Knowers.
Mandala 10.168: It’s like this or that’s my mind, I’m going to follow the cow and the horse. Kuvitsomasyapamiti. They milked like the wind and drank the madness. Kuvitsomasyapamiti. They were drunk and drove their chariots like horses. Kuvitsomasyapamiti. Up ma matirasthita vashra putramiva priyam. Kuvitsomasyapamiti. I’m satisfied and I’m trying to figure out my heart. Kuvitsomasyapamiti. I didn’t have five crops that covered my eyes. Kuvitsomasyapamiti. I don’t have both the heavens and the other side. Kuvitsomasyapamiti. Abhi dya mahina bhuvam abhi3ma prithivi mahim. Kuvitsomasyapamiti. I’m the killer, I’m not going to keep this earth here or here. Kuvitsomasyapamiti. I’m the ocean of the earth, and I’m the thighs here or there. Kuvitsomasyapamiti. I’ve got another wing in the sky3 and I’ve pulled another one down. Kuvitsomasyapamiti. I am the greatest of the great, and I am the greatest of the great. Kuvitsomasyapamiti. The house is decorated with sacrificial offerings to the gods. Kuvitsomasyapamiti.
Mandala 10.169: Atharva, the Brihahiva. Indra:. That servant was the eldest of the worlds, for he was born of Ugrasveṣaṇṛmṇa. He who immediately knows does not borrow from his enemies whom the universe is drunk on. The enemy, whose body is increasing in strength, threatens the servant. They played and played with the sword, and they bowed down in their drunkenness. They also choose to offer sacrifices to you in the universe, and these two are the three young men. The taste of the tasteful is the taste of the creation of the equality of the honey of the honeycomb. This is how the brāhmaṇas allow you to become rich and intoxicated. Ojiyo Dhrishna sthirama Tanusha do not let the evil ones burn you. You ruled us in battles, and we saw many other battles. I encourage you with my weapons and with my words I feed you with the birds of the Brahman. I’m going to praise the Puruvarpa, the lowest of the achievers. He sees the seven demons with his body and witnesses many images. Ni that you’ve got the lowest and the highest in which you can’t live in a bad place. You are the mother of the universe, and you are the source of the universe. These are the Brahman, the great heavens, and the heavenly bodies. The greatness of the tribe is destroyed by the king of the self and the universe is covered by the waters of the self. The same great and great heaven, the Atharva Veda, called itself the body1 of Indra. They kill their sisters, their mothers, their enemies and they increase them with their dead bodies.
Mandala 10.170: Hiranyagarbha, the son of Prajapati. Who(the Creator). Before the deer’s womb was converted, there was only one husband born to the ghost. He sustained the earth and the heavens. To whom shall we offer oblations? He is the giver of self-realization and strength, and the gods worship Him in the universe. Whose shadow is the nectar of whose death? To whom shall we offer oblations? He became the only king of the universe in the blink of an eye while he was alive. He who is the lord of this universe has two legs and four legs. To whom shall we offer oblations? These snow-covered mountains are great and the sea is called Rasa. To whom shall we offer oblations? Whose are these directions and whose arms are these? By Him the heavens and the earth were made strong, and by Him the heavens were stunned. Who is the airplane of the dust in the sky? To whom shall we offer oblations? The one you’re crying for, Avasa, is shining in your mind. Where the sun rises and shines, to whom shall we offer oblations? The waters, which are the source of the universe, are the source of the fire. Then the devatas assembled together and asked: To whom shall we offer oblations? He who saw the waters of the month of Dakṣa, who gave birth to the sacrifice. He who was the only god among the gods, to whom should we offer oblations? May he who was born on earth or who was born in heaven do not harm us. He who gave birth to the bow and the moon and to whom shall we offer oblations? O creator, no one else created these universes besides you. May whatever desires we offer to You be fulfilled and may we become the masters of the Rayas
Mandala 10.171: Chitramaha Vasishta. fire. Jagatih 1,5 You’re not talking about Vasu, the left-handed Sheva, the enemy of the guest. He is the source of the universal fire, the priest of the household, and the source of all energy Juṣāṇa, O fire, take away my words, O Sukrata, the knower of the universe and the winds. Ghritanirnigbrahmane gatumeraya thy devas gave birth to you according to your vow. O mortal, who has covered the seven realms, please kill me for my good deeds. O fire of the sun with the mighty sun, offer the sacrifice which you have made to yourself. The first priest of the sacrifice, Ketu, is the seven horses of the Havishmanta. Hearing the fire, the back of the oil, the eyes, the gods, the powerful, the gods. You are the messenger, the first of the best, and you are the one who is offered to the Lord. The Maruts wiped Thee in the house of Daśuṣa and the Bhrigus chanted Thee with their stomas. Sukrata, who is dear to the sacrifice, offered this milk-producing cow to the sacrificer. Agne ghritasnu trirutas didyadvarti yajnam pariyant sukratuyase. The men worshiped you as their messenger in the morning light. The devatas have increased your kingdom for the sake of greatness, O fire, by cleansing you in the sacrifice. The Vasiṣṭhas did not call you a horse, but they praised you, O fire, in the Vedas. Keep the food of the rice in the sacrifices and always protect us with your blessings.
Mandala 10.172: Veno, the Bhrigu. Venus. This Venus, who is the embryo of the Pṛṣṇi, is the source of the light of the old age and the source of the dust. The brāhmaṇas do not abandon this child of the sun at the confluence of the waters The waves of the sea rise, and the sky shows the back of the deer. The brother of the truth, who lived for a long time, gave birth to the same woman. The mothers of the calf, who were blue, stood in the same position as the previous heroes. The voices of the truth and the nectar are releasing the honey of the nectar. Knowing the appearance of the deer, the brāhmaṇas heard the sound of the buffalo. They are the Gandharvas who know the names of the immortals who are seated on the ocean by the Ṛta. The nymphs, who are wearing a jar, carry it in the highest sky. That Vena wandered about in the wombs of his beloved and died in the wings of his beloved They saw you falling on the nose of the snowflake. The deer-winged messenger of Varuna is the bird in the womb of Yama. The Gandharva above him stood above his nose, carrying his weapons. Vasana atkam surabhi sight whom heavenly name beget dear ones. They watched the vulture’s eyes as they crossed the ocean. The sun, shining with the brightness of Venus, made the dear ones in the third wheel.
Mandala 10.175: This is our sacrifice, O fire, which is fivefold, threefold and sevenfold. They have been our priests in the sacrificial fire and have been waiting for us for a long time. The cave of the god is the source of the god, and I am immortal when I see it. I leave the auspicious one who is auspicious and do not bow down to the forest of my own friend. Seeing another guest, the young woman was in the abode of the truth. I praise my father, the demon, and I share in the sacrifice of Sheva. I leave my father, who has been in the midst of many years, seeking Indra. Fire, moon and Varuna are the sources of the universe. They were created by the demons, and you, O Varuna, do not desire them. O king, distinguish between truth and falsehood, and come to the throne of my kingdom. This is the voice, this is the left, this is the light, this is the space. Kill Vritra and remove the moon, and we offer oblations to the saint. The poet, after poetry, took on a form in the heavens, and the powerful Varuna created the waterless. The seas are not the source of the welfare of the people They are the pure ones who fill his colour. They are the ones who move his eldest sense, and they are the ones who feed him with their own sacrifice. They did not ask for a king, but they were afraid of Vṛtrāsura. They say that the swan is accompanied by the terrible ones, and that the waters are the friends of the divine. The poets and the wise did not heal Indra, who was chanting the Anuṣṭubha.
Mandala 10.176: Vagambhrni. soul., Jagti. I move among the Rudras and Vasus, and I move among the suns and the universal demigods. I am Mitra and Varuna, I am Indra, the fire, and I am Aśvinobha. I carry the moon, I carry the moon, I carry the sun, I carry the moon, and I carry the moon. I offer the wealth to the Havishmata, the Supravya3, the Sunvata, the sacrificer. I am the national confluence of the Vasus, the healer of the Vasus, and the first of the sacrificial animals. That which the demigods gave me, the ancients, was the source of all the earth. I have said that he who sees, he who lives, he who hears, eats. They devour Me without end, listen, listen, I tell you with faith. I’m the one who says this myself, whether it’s the gods or the humans. That which I desire I make him fierce, that Brahman, that sage, that Sumedha. I stretch out my bow to Rudra, killing him with my arrows, the enemy of the brāhmaṇas. I am the one who makes the people equal, and I entered the heavens and the earth. I gave birth to the head of the father, and my womb was in the sea. Then I stand behind the earth and touch the heavens with the rain. I am the same as the wind, blowing the worlds and the universe. The next day was the next day and the next day was the same as the earth.
Mandala 10.177: Not that great, nor evil, nor the gods, nor the eight mortals. They are the friends of Yama and Aryama who are very enemies of Sajoṣa. That is what we ask of you, Varuna, my friend and noble one. By which you may be free from violence and may not be the enemies of mortals. They must be our friend Varuna and Aryama. The younger ones are taking us away and the younger ones are driving us away from our enemies. You are the universe, Varuna, Mitra and Aryama. We shall be well brought to your shame and dear to your enemies. The suns are very bright, and Varuna is the friend of Aryama. The fierce Maruts offered sacrifices to Indra, the fire, for the welfare of the enemies. Netar oo shu nastiro Varuna mitra Aryama. They are very wicked kings of the universe and very enemies of the watchmen. Varuna, the friend of Aryama, gave us the dog. May the suns first grant us peace if we are very hostile. Just as the Vasus, the sacrificial animals, released the cow at the foot of the city. They are the ones who have released us from the trouble of saving us from the fire of life.
Mandala 10.178: The night is explained by the Purutra and the Devi1ksha. Visva adhi shrio adhita. Orvapra, the immortal, is the source of the goddess1dvata. Light interferes with darkness. Niru gave her sister-in-law a smile. Apedu laughs at the darkness. That’s us today whose we don’t want to go to. The tree does not live in the age. There were no villages, no footprints, no birds. Ni shyenas chidarthina:. The young wolf1 is the wolf, and the young wolf is the thief. Then be our Sutara. Up ma pepishattama: krishnam vyaktam sthita. Usha goes like a debt. Ask for the cows to be upon you, daughter of the heavens. You didn’t win the night stomach.
Mandala 10.179: The Visvedevas., Jagti. May my fire shine in the sky, and we may nourish your body. Let the four directions bow down to me and let us conquer the army under your command. May all my gods, Indra, Maruts, Vishnu and Agni, be in the air. May the sky and the heavens be mine and may the wind blow in me in this desire. May the gods offer their sacrifices to Me, and may the sacrifices of the gods be blessed in Me. The divine priests who were in the past became unfortunate and we became very brave. Let them sacrifice to me whatever sacrifices I offer, and may the sound of my mind be true. Eno ma ni ga katamaccanaham visve devaso adhi vocata us. May the goddess ṣalu and Vīruru protect us in the universe and may the demigods protect us in this world. Let us not lose our progeny, let us not enjoy our bodies, let us not hate the moon, O King. O fire, protect us from the cows who are burning against the anger of others. Let them go back to the right place and let them go back to their minds. I am the creator of the creators of the universe, the lord of the gods, the savior of the universe. May the gods Aśvinobha and Brihaspati protect this sacrifice from the performer of the sacrifice. Uruvyacha no buffalo shame yansadasminhave puruhūta purukṣuḥ. He is the horse of the deer for our progeny, O Indra, do not resent us, do not give us others. May those who are our enemies become our enemies, and may we forbid them with the fires of Indra. The Vasus, the Rudras and the suns touched the fierce Chettara and made him their king.
Mandala 10.180: The Creator is the Supreme Being. The circle of emotions. There was nothing that was always there for us, and there was no dust that was beyond us. What is the deep water? Whose shame is it? What is the deep water? There was no death, no nectar, no night, no day, no light. He brought the wind with his own sacrifice, and therefore he did not choose anything else. The darkness was covered with darkness, and the waters were all unlit. That which was covered with insignificance was born of the glory of austerity. Lust, which was the first semen of the mind, was the source of all desire. The wise and the intelligent are the ones who find the true friend in their hearts. The rays of the Tiraschino spread out below them and sweat above them. They were the semen-givers, the glorious ones, the Svadhas, the Avastas, the Prayatis, and the Parastas. Who knows half of it, who told it here, where did it come from, and where did it come from? Who knows where the Arvagdevas were born when he was discharged? This is the dissolution that happened, whether it was given or not. He who is the presiding deity of this universe in the highest heaven knows it or does not know it.
Mandala 10.181: Sukirti is like a cockroach. Indra,4-5 Ashwins.
Mandala 10.182: Up pracha Indra, knock down the universe, the enemy, the sinful, the overwhelmed. The north and the south are the source of your shame. Kuvidang yavamanto yavam chidyatha danti anupurvam viyuya. Here, here, make food for those who have not gone to the peacock’s bow tree. There is no stable season that has passed, nor is there any hearing in the various confluences. The brahmins gave cows to Indra for their friend and gave him horses and bulls. You’ve got Surama and Aśvinī-kumāra in the demon Sacha. Vipipana Shubhaspati Indra Karmasvavatam. Like a son, the fathers of the Aśvinī-kumāras were bitten by poets. That nectar which you drank with the Sachis and the Sarasvatī bathed you like Indra. May Indra, the Sutrama, be the source of all the Vedas. May hatred hinder us and may we be the masters of the mighty. We shall be his good friend and his sacrificial friend. May that Sutrama, the self-born Indra, bestow upon us all hatred.

Mandala 10.188: I know that the heavens are the source of the demons and that the earth is the source of all my beauty. May the gods and the Aśvinī-kumāras increase their knowledge. That you, Mitra and Varuna, hold the earth, and you are the Sushumneshita, and you are the one who is sacrificed to you. We shall fight with our friends to destroy you and the demon. We’re going to cut half of what we’re doing, and we’re going to fall on the right side of the screen. I gave you that which nourishes the moon and the stars of the moon. Asavan, O demon, give birth to the heavens, for you are Varuna, the king of the universe. The head of the chariot was cut off by the sword of death. In this self3tachchakaputa, this one kills the heroes who have gone to his friend’s interest. Avorva yaddhattanushvava: priyasu yajniyasvarva. Your mother, the sun, is unconscious, and the heavens and the earth are not covered with milk. Av priya didishtana sura ninikta rays. You are the king of the dreams, and you are not the chariot of the king of the forest. They are making us particles There is a human sacrifice and there is a good sacrifice.
Mandala 10.190: Pro svasmai purorathamindraya śūṣamarcata. They are now in the company of the creators of the worlds, the killers of Vritra, and they are encouraged to fly on the bows of others. You created the sea and killed the serpent. O Indra, you are the enemy, you have borne the universe, you nourish the waters, so we embrace you, and you are the sky of others, whose bows are on the bows. Vi ṣu visva aratyo aryo naśant no dhiyāḥ. You are killing the enemy who does not want to kill us, O Indra. He who does not teach us the life of a wolf, who is not afraid of Indra. Make her the lowest foot, and you are the one who can bear the others’ bows. He who does not serve the Indras and who is not satisfied with the Sanas. Let his strength be lifted up like the earth and the heavens by himself, and let the bows of others be lifted up. We, Indra, enjoy your friendship. The path of truth has led us to the worlds, and the evils of others have been lifted up on the bows. O Indra, teach us that which milks the best of the old. The earth gave us milk with a thousand streams like a cow with a thousand streams of milk.
Mandala 10.191: The young Yamayana. Yama:. Yama drinks from the tree in which the gods drink. Here our father, the lord of the universe, is following the ancients. They followed the Puranas and walked in the sinful world. I was jealous of him and I didn’t want him anymore. The young man who had a new chariot and wheel in his mind. You stand in the ocean seeing the fifth of the universe alone. The young man who rode the chariot to the brāhmaṇas. They followed him together, and the boat was not hindered. Who gave birth to the boy and who stopped the chariot? Who can tell us today what happened to Anudeyi? As it happened, Anudeyi was born first. The Buddha is extended from the front and the hell is extended from the back. This is the Yama’s vessel, which is called the Devamana. This is his smoking pipe, this is his dressing.
Mandala 10.194: Rishyashringa, (these are the sages who eat the wind). Keshinah = fire, sun and wind. Keshi1 fire, Keshi poison, Keshi carries the sky. Keshi is the light of the universe in the heavenly vision. The sages are wind-eaters and the white dwellers are dirty. They follow the wind in the sky, which the gods have seen. We’re mad and silent, and we’re standing there. You mortals are looking at our bodies. The universe falls through space and appears. The sage is the friend and benefactor of the gods for the good of the gods. The horse of the wind is the friend of the wind and the sage is desired by the gods. Both the seas and the fields are the former and the latter. They walked at the feet of the Apsaras, Gandharvas and Deer. Keshi is a learned friend of Keta and a delicious drunkard. The wind is stirring us up and crushing us. Keshi drank with Rudra in a vessel of poison.
Mandala 10.197: The Visvedevas. Or, O gods, may you raise the devas again. Utaga cried out to the gods, may you revive the gods. These two winds are the winds of the Sindhura and the Paravata. May another blow your right hand and may another blow your right hand. A wind blows the medicine, and the wind blows the water. You are the universal healer and the messenger of the gods. I’ve come to you with a chariot of peace and evil. I wish you good fortune and I bestow upon you the supreme tuberculosis. May the gods and the Maruts protect me here. May all beings be saved as this water is not. Apa idva u bheshajirapo amivachatanih. Water is the medicine of all things and may they become the medicine. The tongue is the precursor of the speech with the ten branches of the hands. We touch you with these two things that make you unclean.

Mandala 10.199: Or worldly. You are the sacrificial fire for the gods. Do not come to the sun, the Rudras and the Vasus, nor to the earth. This is the sacrifice, this is the word, and you are offering it. We offer you the sacrifice of the dead, we offer you the sacrifice of the earth. I praise You, the Jataveda, the universal source of knowledge. O fire, bring us the gods who are dear to us and who are dear to us. Agni became the god of the gods and the priest of the gods, and the sages worshiped him. I offered the great fire for the sake of wealth and the earth for the sake of wealth.
