Like blue lotuses filled with water. The lady went to all ladies. In that moment, compassion illuminated her.
Ayodhya Kand.503: Step by step she weaves the fine fabric with great love. Her heart is filled with joy and bliss as she stays.
Ayodhya Kand.504: Evening Sanehnasi all the queens. Sitting in the morning they spoke Gur Gyani. Saying the worlds motion is Maya, Muni Nath said. He spoke a little about Paramartha. He told the king to spread the beauty of Surapura. Hearing this, Raghunath felt two sorrows. Considering his death, he examined his own deeds. Very evening, he slowly and steadily bore it. The harsh Kulisi heard harsh words. Bilapati Lakhani all the queens. Very sorrowful, the evening assembly. I think King is idle today. Muni Bar explained much to Rama. Together, the society did not improve. He took a vow of Nirambu for that day. Muni said he did not drink even water.
Ayodhya Kand.505: Dawn came and Raghunandana, the sage, arrived indeed. With devotion and reverence, they welcomed the Lord with respect.
Ayodhya Kand.506: Performing actions as prescribed in the Vedas, burning away impurities. Born as the pure and the destroyer of sin. A name is a fire that cannot be weighed. Recalling all is the root of auspiciousness. Indeed, fear is overcome by the virtuous and the agreed upon. A pilgrimage call to the sweet river. Indeed, by the two breasts, time passes. The guru spoke, Ram is the beloved. The Lord makes all sufferings disappear. Like the root, fruit, and water of the fig tree. Sanj, filled with ministers, all mothers. Seeing, I am lost as if in an age. All together, the city bears the tradition. You remain immortal in Amaravati. I have said much and done much. It is fitting that you, Gosain, do it.
Ayodhya Kand.507: Who can describe the ocean of compassion that is Ram? People find rest after seeing his two days of sorrow.
Ayodhya Kand.508: Hearing Ram's words, the fearful assembly was like a distressed fish in the ocean. Hearing the guru's words, which were the root of all auspiciousness, it was as if the wind became favorable. They bathed in the holy waters at that time, by merely seeing which, all sins are destroyed. Filling their eyes with the auspicious form, they joyfully prostrated. They went to see Ram's mountain forest, where there is all happiness and no sorrow. Waterfalls flow with nectar-like water, removing the three types of suffering and the three types of winds. There are countless varieties of trees, creepers, and grasses, with many kinds of fruits, flowers, and leaves. Beautiful rocks and the shade of comforting trees. Who can describe the beauty of the forest?
Ayodhya Kand.509: The creeper saroruh shakes and murmurs like water, resonating like a bee. The deer dances and leaps, colorful and vibrant.
Ayodhya Kand.510: Each kiraṭ Bhill has a dwelling. Madhu sucī is beautiful and sweet. Full of fat, the calf grows in the hūrī. The bulb, root, fruit, and sprout are juicy. All these are made without any addition. Some have different tastes and praises. People do not like to eat much. Around Rām Dohāī gives people. Sometimes love and longing in soft words. The saint recognizes the humble and the lowly. You are the impure and we are the low caste. Pāvā gets Rāms favor by seeing Him. We are beyond the ordinary and very special to you. Jas keeps the mark of the divine.
Ayodhya Kand.511: He who knows this fears not at all, nor does he hesitate to write it. We begin to do what is meaningful, plucking the blade of grass as it sprouts.
Ayodhya Kand.512: You are dear to be looked upon, and you bear the burden of service. Devotion is not a part of our actions. We are servants of the Lord, and He is our God. This is our great service. We do not hide, nor do we hide as thieves. We are like lifeless beings, harming living beings, cheating, and deceiving. We commit sins nightly, but our bodies do not decay, nor do our hearts become callous. I seek the duty of righteousness and wisdom. This is Ragunandana, a sight of glory. When the Lord looks at the lotus of his feet, all our sufferings, faults, and sins are erased. We hear the words of the wise, and they are filled with affection. They approve of our actions.
Ayodhya Kand.513: Praising the beloved, one cherishes all affection and conveys it. Speaking and meeting, serving and adoring, one finds bliss by writing and knowing. Man and woman, near and far, hear and feel the inner voice. Tulsidas, by the grace of Raghuvamsi, took the pen and wrote this.
Ayodhya Kand.514: As they wandered in the forest, people were delighted on all sides. Just as water makes Datura plants and peacocks happy at the beginning of the rainy season.
Ayodhya Kand.515: Men and women are very dear. Time passes like a blink of an eye. A maid serves with a false face. She humbly serves as a devotee. Without Rama, there is no life; Maya is all about Siyas Maya. The maid serves Siya and learns to be content. With Siya, two simple brothers are happy. The crooked queen is a betrayer. Earth does not split, nor does it divide. Poets say that without Rama, one is in hell. Everyones heart is filled with this. Rama does not abandon, nor does he fall into hell. This thought is in everyones mind. Rama governs by his will and does not need an end.
Ayodhya Kand.516: Until night brings sleep, hunger will keep one awake all day, pondering, wavering between low and less low, as if in a constrained sea.
Ayodhya Kand.517: Some mothers wept for their black-eyed daughters. Thus, thus, as they were old. Some ways Rama was crowned. I was not separated from Him. Then again, the guru appeared as a mother. The sage again spoke of Ramas charm. The mother said, Again, Rama is the son of Raghu. Rama, by force, took her. I acted according to His words. If by force, then I would behave with humility. Hari, the Lord, is the servant of the guru. One thought did not remain in my mind. Thinking, I remained silent. I bathed in the morning, the Lord on my head. Sitting, I read, the sage spoke.
Ayodhya Kand.518: The devotees worship the image of the perfect guru. All the prominent Bipra merchants and truthful members of the assembly are present.
Ayodhya Kand.519: Munibur says time is equal. Hear O members all wise and clear. Dhurin supports Dhuni, favoring Bhanu. King Ram rules as the Lord. Truth is the bridge, the protector of the heard. Ramas birth brings joy to the world. Guru, father, and mother guide us. Allies and friends are helpers of the divine. Policy and affection are for the highest good, not personal gain. None can be like Rama, known to all. Hari appears in seasons, Maya binds life, time, and karma. Wherever power is established, yoga, siddhi, and knowledge are praised. Considering all, one sees Ramas beauty every morning.
Ayodhya Kand.520: Keep Ram, Rajai, and Rukh, let all of us be beneficial to each other. Understanding this, we say goodbye now, all having agreed to sleep together.
Ayodhya Kand.521: All say blessed is Ram, the groom. Happy is the marriage, the root of all good. Some say the duration of the wedding is for Raghuram. Knowing this, some understand and act accordingly. All the sages heard the words of the sage. New bliss, not selfish gain, is the essence. The people did not leave until dawn. Then the sun did not allow the noise to continue. The sun became the king, dark and fierce. More than one, one great. For the sake of people, all say the parents. Good and bad karma, given by God. Sorrow and happiness, all good. Asiees and Rauri, the world knows. So the saint, in a way, showed the path. He who takes can carry, he who cannot, cannot.
Ayodhya Kand.522: I understand now and feel ashamed of all this. Hearing the sweet affection, my heart embraces the love in my bosom.
Ayodhya Kand.523: Father speaks, saying a word. Buddha goes, leaving all behind. You two brothers are the forest and the garden. Fleeing, Lakhna becomes Sita, Raghuraam. Hearing, the two brothers are filled with joy. Bhem sings, complete in pleasure. Mind is pleased, body is bright. Janu becomes a king, loving Rama. Many gain, few lose. Equal is pain and joy, all is silent, queen. Bharat, the sage, said thus. This fruit is the will of life in the world. I will sing, filling the whole life with beauty. This is more than I can ever be.
Ayodhya Kand.524: Ramu Siya the interlocutor, you are universally knowledgeable. Who speaks thus, the Lord shows his own way of salvation.
Ayodhya Kand.525: Hearing Bharat's words and seeing his love, the sage, along with the assembly, became detached from the body. Bharat is a great ocean of glory. The sage's intellect is like a weak woman on the shore. He tried to cross it in his heart, but found neither a boat nor a brave sailor. Who else can praise Bharat? Can a small pond or a shell contain the ocean? Bharat, in his heart, became the sage. The assembly, with Sita, came to Ram. The Lord, after being saluted, gave them good seats. All sat down, listening to the sage's instructions. The chief sage spoke thoughtful words, appropriate to the place, time, and occasion. Listen, Ram, all-knowing and wise one, about dharma, policy, virtues, and knowledge.
Ayodhya Kand.526: Every heart contains both good and evil. Men and women fill their hearts with benefit, so say the wise.
Ayodhya Kand.527: Think before you speak, and speak what you know. The wise and the sages speak of the preservation of life. The Lord is in your hands, seek His help. Always keep a helpful and protective heart. When you speak, do so with joy and in a pleasant manner. First, whatever you speak, believe it. With your heart, learn and understand. Again, as Goswamis say whatever, do so in the same manner. The sage speaks the truth, Bhartari does not keep a grudge. Thus, thus he speaks, thus he speaks. Bhartari is settled in devotion, his mind is fixed on devotion. Bhartari knows joy, keeps a pleasant demeanor. Whatever he does, he does it well and beautifully.
Ayodhya Kand.528: Listen respectfully to Bharat's humble request and then consider it again. Extract the essence of the opinions of saints, the public, royal policy, and the Vedas.
Ayodhya Kand.529: The gurus affection filled his heart. Ramas heart was especially filled with joy. Bharata knew the steadfast Dharma. His body and mind were his own servant. The guru spoke in a manner pleasing to the disciple. His words were gentle and full of auspiciousness. The master and the path, the father and the feet, he revered. Fear not, for Bharata is like a brother. He who has the gurus feet like a lotus in affection, such people are great and wise. If there is any affection like this, who can say Bharata has run away. Writing and binding a friend, the mind is made sharp. Bharata did great deeds as he spoke. Bharata did well as he spoke, thus Rama remained satisfied.
Ayodhya Kand.530: Then the sage spoke: Bhartari was filled with sorrow and distress. Oh beloved friend, heart, what is the matter?.
Ayodhya Kand.531: Hearing the words of Munis, Ramas virtues were seen. Guru Sahib is favorable, not an enemy. Writing down in my heart, Sabin, the young one, was burdened. Unable to say anything, unable to think. The body became deaf and dumb. The eyes were dry, tears flowed. Saying, O Mor Muninath, I am satisfied. I cannot say more than this. I know my own Lord, beautiful and perfect. I do not blame others. I am special in grace, playing without killing. I avoid Sisupalas fate, never breaking my mind. I live by the Lords grace, winning and losing in play.
Ayodhya Kand.532: My hearts affection cannot be concealed; my eyes remain unsatisfied even in sight.
Ayodhya Kand.533: By fate I cannot be the true devotee Dalia. I am lowly, born in the middle, unable to cross. I say today I will not find beauty. Understanding myself, the wise will consider me a fool. My mother was slow, I was raised by a wise person. In my heart, I concealed a thousand secrets. Further, I nurtured a calf, a beautiful doe. My crown was in childbirth, a wreath of suffering. In dreams, I saw no beauty. I am incomplete, a bird without a home. Without understanding, I cannot perfect my own nature. I remain, as my mother said, a crow. Seeing hearts, I am captivated by all. In one way, I am good, in another, better, my dear. Guru Gosai, my Lord Rama, I cling to your beauty, my sweet result.
Ayodhya Kand.534: Righteous assembly, I speak to the guru near, being steadfast in truth. Love, the universe, how can a saintly person lie or hide it.
Ayodhya Kand.535: The king is dead, long live the king. The mother is wise, she is the keeper of all. Seeing this, the great lady does not weep. When it is hard for both men and women. The earth considers all as meaningless, I understand everything after hearing this. Hearing this, Raghunatha became a king, and Laxman, the sage, joined Sita as a companion. Without drinking, they ate. Sankar is a witness, I remain as this. Often I see the love of the Nishad. The Kulis is hard, but the heart is not afraid. Now I see everything with my eyes. Life and death, all are helpers. When I saw the snake in front of me, the poison fang was there.
Ayodhya Kand.536: Then Raghunandana wrote Sikhandin Ahita. In her, the daughter brought comfort to suffering and pain.
Ayodhya Kand.537: Hear the very late night words. Joy, love, and separation are the songs. Sorrow and despair fill all gatherings. The mind becomes a lotus, blooming for you. Many times the sage narrated ancient tales. The wise sage who enlightened Bharat spoke. Suitable words, Raghunandana, to save ones life. Dinakars lineage became Chandu. Father, if you wish to live, know your fate. I am three ages, Tibusan, and beyond. I came to you, my body twisted. Go to the world of the dead, not the living. Friends, the body and root are gone. Those who do not gather with gurus and saints.
Ayodhya Kand.538: All sinful illusions and the entire burden of inauspiciousness are destroyed. Worldly fame and otherworldly happiness are attained by remembering and bowing to you.
Ayodhya Kand.539: I say, beauty is in truth, like a sacred text. Bharats land remains, keeping its promise. Fathers, let the seekers not fall into enmity. There is no enduring enmity, nor enduring hatred. Muni sings nearby, deer do not fear. Adversaries are seen, but not feared. Benefit or harm, animals know their way. Humans have bodies, virtues are their wealth. I know this well, I will not act in discord. Keeping truth, one may sacrifice. Flee the body, let go of enmity. Thus, in thought, one finds safety. This is more, your concern is less. But the guru came to guide. As I said, so it has been.
Ayodhya Kand.540: Only I can please Man by giving up my life, say I will do so today. Hearing the truth and the bond of Raghuwar, the society became happy.
Ayodhya Kand.541: With Sur (music) and Sahitya (lyrics), Suraraj. Thinking and desiring to be Akajoo (a bird). Not doing anything, just sitting and singing. Ram Saran, all in my mind. Thinking and reflecting, they say to each other. Raghupati, settled in devotion. Ambareesh, with wisdom, defeated Durvasa. Sur, Surpati, defeated with music. Sur, for many years, was sad. Narharirao, revealed Prahlada. Holding and holding, singing and touching the head. Now, Surs work, filling hands. Coming and sitting, Deva. Knowing, Ram, the devoted servant. Remembering, all, filled with devotion. Rama, with his own virtues, settled.
Ayodhya Kand.542: Hearing the words of the divine teacher, I say, O my heart, you are very dear. You fill all the auspicious roots of the world with your affection.
Ayodhya Kand.543: The service of the Lord of Sita, the servant, and the maidservant, is like the Kamadhenu cow. Bharat's devotion has come to your mind. Abandon worry, destiny has made the way. See the influence of Bharat, O wife of the gods. Raghurao is naturally overwhelmed. Steady your mind, O gods, there is no fear. Knowing Bharat to be Ram's shadow. Listen, O preceptor of gods, the gods agree with this thought. The indwelling Lord feels hesitation. Bharat knew the burden on his own head. He made countless estimations in his heart. After much thought, he made up his mind. Ram's command is his own good. Abandoning his own vow, he kept my vow. He did not betray the love of all four.
Ayodhya Kand.544: With boundless grace, O Amit, O Sitānāth. Bowing in reverence, I speak with great force, touching the waters with my hands.
Ayodhya Kand.545: I speak the saying now my master. Please be the mediator O Ambunidhi. Gur Prasann Sahib is favorable. My mind conceived a form of the deity. I do not think of anything at all. Lord, do not be a false god, do not disappear. I am a broken bird, a crooked mother, a difficult time, a harsh fate. I have gathered everything, enticed, and embraced. I have taken care of myself and my own. This is not a new way, nor will it be forgotten. People are not foolish, they do not go astray. The world is not bad, there is one Gosain who is good. Say that it is good, it is good. The Lord is the tree of gods, facing both north and south.
Ayodhya Kand.546: Come near for recognition, but keep your mind balanced. Accept what is acceptable, and let the world change without being disturbed.
Ayodhya Kand.547: Write all ways guru Swami Saneh. No doubt remains in the mind. Now Karunakar has become so. Lord for the sake of people, he is ever alert. Whoever servant of the master is shy. His own interest is desired, such mind is not good. Serving the masters interest is servants duty. Achieve all happiness by giving up greed. Always return to selfishness. Such selfishness is ultimate selfishness. All good deeds fruit is beauty in the eyes of the Lord. God hears my plea. Do what is appropriate for your worship. Tilak, the decoration of society, comes all. By doing so, the Lord accepts my mind.
Ayodhya Kand.548: Send me with my younger brother, and everyone will be protected. Otherwise, both brothers will turn back, and I will go with them.
Ayodhya Kand.549: Otherwise, all three brothers will go to the forest. And Raghurao will return with his wife. In whatever way the Lord's mind becomes pleased, O ocean of compassion, do that. O gods, all of you are a burden to me. I have no consideration for policy or dharma. All words are spoken for self-interest. No one remembers the distressed in their heart. A servant who answers back after hearing the master's command feels ashamed. I am such a deep ocean of faults. Saints praise the master's love. Now, O merciful one, I like that idea. Let the master's mind not feel any hesitation. I swear by the Lord's feet, I speak the truth. For the welfare of the world, there is one solution.
Ayodhya Kand.550: The Lord being pleased, the mind is delighted; as He comes, so let us welcome and bow down before Him.
Ayodhya Kand.551: Hearing Bharat's pure words, the gods rejoiced. Saints praised him, and gods showered flowers. The residents of Ayodhya were overwhelmed with emotion. The ascetics living in the forest were delighted. Raghunath remained silent, feeling hesitant. Seeing the Lord's state, the entire assembly pondered. Janak's messengers arrived at that moment. Hearing this, Muni Vashishtha quickly called them. After saluting, they looked at Ram. Seeing his attire, they became extremely distressed. The chief sage asked the messengers, "Tell us about the well-being of King Videha." Hearing this, they bowed their heads in shame. The four best messengers spoke with folded hands, "You ask respectfully, O Lord. That is why there is well-being, O Goswami."
Ayodhya Kand.552: There is no Koshala Nath nor Kusala Nath with him. Mithila Avadh is especially where all become orphaned.
Ayodhya Kand.553: King Dasharatha heard the news and Janaka was overwhelmed with sorrow. Seeing what he saw, he felt the time of parting. The name is true, it feels no other way. Queen Kucali heard Narapala, without thinking, without a plan. Bharata, the king of Raghubar, settled in. He loved Mithileh in his heart. The king understood the wise minister and society. After thinking, he said what is right today. Understanding, the two agreed, neither going nor staying. The king thought deeply, holding his heart. Reading the Avadh, the clever one read the four. Understanding, Bharata felt the truth in his heart. Begging came, but not known.
Ayodhya Kand.554: I have seen the four great epics of India recited. Four traveled to Chitrakuta, thirteen traveled elsewhere.
Ayodhya Kand.555: The messenger came to fulfill his task. Janaks society was transformed according to the meeting. Upon hearing, the guru, his disciples, and the minister Mahipati thought deeply with affection. With patience and composure, he undertook the great task. Taking beautiful words, he spoke them. Keeping the home, village, and country safe, he left many to take care of. The milkmaid went at the right time. Without resting, Mahipala did his work. In the morning, he bathed in Prayaga. He went to Jumna and brought everyone with him. We will read the news, Lord. He said, This is my name, Naya, on your head. We went together for seven years. The sage immediately said goodbye and left.
Ayodhya Kand.556: Janak heard and became very happy. Raghunandana had great thoughts and plans for the welfare of the society.
Ayodhya Kand.557: He who plants a seed reaps a harvest. As man reaps joy from the earth. Fear in the morning, peace in the evening. Thus, the day passes. The mind is calm, all are peaceful. Women and men worship the divine. Ganap and Gouri, they rule with grace. Rama, the beloved, his feet are a barrier. Unbreakable are the arms of the invincible. King Rama, Janaki, and Rani. Anand, Avadi, Avadh, the capital. Subhas, the sage, teaches all. Rama is the king in the hearts of Bharat. Thus, happiness and purity flow through all. The gods bestow life on the world.
Ayodhya Kand.558: May Ram's reign be established in the city with the assembly of gurus and brothers. While Ram is the King, everyone in Avadh wishes to die.
Ayodhya Kand.559: Hear the words of the beloved man. Scorn those yogis and munis who are idle in knowledge. Thus, the man constantly performs good deeds. Bowing to Rama, his heart is filled with joy. High, low, and middle, men and women. Each sees the reflection of their own likeness. Be cautious, respect every moment. All are worthy of praise, a treasury of grace. These are the words of Raghubar. Recognizing duty and affection. Like a seal, like a wave, like Raghus offspring. With beautiful face, beautiful eyes, simple and charming. Rama says, praising virtues, everyone feels admiration. We are all equal, a heap of good deeds in the world. Those who know Rama, they recognize us.
Ayodhya Kand.560: Prem Magon those moments all hear of Mithilesu. Suhit Sabha tension rises and Rabikul Kamal days come.
Ayodhya Kand.561: Brother Secretary Guru Purajan is here. Ahead is King Raghu. On Giribar, Janakpati is seen. Bowing, the chariot is left behind. Rams sight is longed for. Path of labor, without rest, is endured. Wherever the heart is, Raghuvir is present. Without the heart and body, joy and sorrow have no meaning. Janak comes, moving in this way. With society, love, wisdom, and mother earth. Coming near, love is seen. Meeting is respectful, feeling mutual. Muni Janak bows to Raghunandana. Brothers together, Ram meets and rules. They go, bringing society together.
Ayodhya Kand.562: The hermitage is like an ocean, the saints are like pure, holy paths. The army is as if a river of compassion, where Ragunath goes.
Ayodhya Kand.563: Study and ponder a wise decision. Seek a thousand paths for your way. Think and tie the threads of thought. Destroy the weeds of ignorance with the sword of knowledge. Flow like a river of devotion. Fear and confusion are endless. Only the wise carry the burden of knowledge. Do not see this as an end. Carefully consider the fruits of your actions. Remain without a partner, losing all hope. Find the forest of peace when you leave. Rise like a cloud, filled with knowledge. Understand the two realms of sorrow and joy. Seek the wisdom that calms the mind. Beauty and virtues are all-encompassing. Sorrow and tribulation are endless.
Ayodhya Kand.564: Deep in sorrow like the sea, thinking of man and woman, greatly agitated. All faults, all sorrows, speaking in confusion, thus said the poet. Seeing the gods, siddhas, ascetics, sages, the devotee bid them farewell. None can match Tulsidas in love, as he can in devotion.
Ayodhya Kand.565: Inimitable is the teaching where the people are the sages. With patience dwelling, Bhisma spoke the knowledge to Veda Vyasa.
Ayodhya Kand.566: The sun of knowledge dispelled the night of worldly existence. The rays of his words made the lotus of the sages bloom. That which removes delusion and attachment. This is the greatness of Sita and Ram. The wise and perfected seekers of worldly pleasures. The Vedas describe three types of beings in the world. Ram's presence makes the mind full of knowledge. The support of the assembly of saints grows. That knowledge is not without Ram's love. Just as a boat without a helmsman. Many sages gathered. Everyone bathed at Ramghat. All men and women were filled with sorrow. That day passed without food. Animals, birds, and deer did not eat. There was no thought of dear relatives.
Ayodhya Kand.567: Two societies visited Nariraj and Raghuraj early in the morning for bathing. Sitting there, everyone was silent and lost in thought, singing.
Ayodhya Kand.568: Raj Janak lived in Dasaratha Pur in Mahisur. He was the resident of the city of Mithila. Hamsa Bansa was his guru, and he was known as Purodha. They searched for the supreme in the world. Many teachings were imparted, including the new understanding of dharma and wisdom. Kaushik narrated ancient stories, explaining them to everyone in the assembly. Then Raghunath, Kaushik said, would remain without water like Kali, a lord. The sage said appropriately to Raghuraai, going through the night for thirteen days. Rishi Rukh described the seventeen treasures, but it is not appropriate here to mention the grains. Bhup said well, getting up early in the morning, going to take a bath with his queen.
Ayodhya Kand.569: That opportunity yields flowers, fruits, and a multitude in various ways. It comes with a vast and heavy load of bountiful leaves.
Ayodhya Kand.570: Giri Ram Prasad in desire. Observing and stealing pleasure. Saras becomes the division of land. Janu reaches with joy and affection. Beli bites and succeeds in all. Birds, animals, and Ali are pleased. Thus, opportunities become more desirable. Triply mixed, blissful, and all. Do not go, charming and delightful. Janu does the role of Janak. Then everyone bathes. Ram Janak the sage comes. Looking, looking, with affection for trees. Wherever, people rise. Fruits, leaves, roots, and tubers of various kinds. Pleasing, beautiful, and similar to nectar.
Ayodhya Kand.571: Only Ramgur shall we read aloud, filled to the brim with weight. Honoring ancestors, gods, guests, teachers—thus we perform our duties.
Ayodhya Kand.572: This way time passes four hours. Ram sees men and women happily. The society is pleasing to the mind. Without Sita, Ram is not well. Sita and Ram live together. Koti Amarpur is full of prosperity. Remove Lakhana, Ram is in a fair. Where there is love, there is this way. On the right, it happens every morning. Ram settles near him then. Mandakini bathed for three days. Seeing Ram, Muda is pleased with a blessing. Eight Ram becomes a tapas on the mountain. Asan Amis equal is a great root fruit. With happiness, together, two and seven. In a moment, it becomes and does not become old.
Ayodhya Kand.573: This bliss, yoga, no one can say where it is found. Natural beauty, society enjoys, in the devotion of Ramas name.
Ayodhya Kand.574: Thus, all desires are fulfilled. Life is spent listening to love. The mother taught at the right time. The opportunity came seeing the maidservants. All the ladies of the palace came to see. Janakaraja and Rnivasu came to see. With due respect, Suman welcomed Kaushalya. She was seated in her due place. The affection of the mother spread everywhere. Seeing and hearing the harshness of the clan. The pulse softened, the body became visible. The womans nails wrote, thinking of everything. All the ladies of the palace were the form of love for Rama. Janaks tears flowed abundantly. The mother said wisely. Those who feed and clothe are remembered.
Ayodhya Kand.575: Listen to Sudha, see her, do as she does. Wherever she goes, crows, parrots, and thoughts follow her.
Ayodhya Kand.576: Hearing this, Devi Sumitra said with sorrow, 'The ways of destiny are strange and contrary. He who creates, sustains, and then destroys, plays like a child, such is the deluded mind of destiny.' Kaushalya said, 'No one is to blame. Due to the sway of karma, sorrow and happiness are received. The ways of destiny are difficult to understand, it is the giver of all good and bad fruits. This king has done this naturally. Creation, sustenance, and dissolution are for the immortal. Devi, do not grieve due to delusion. The creation of destiny is eternal and unmoving. The king will now go to the forest and die. O friend, think about the harm to your own welfare.' Sita's mother said with true and good words, 'O queen of Avadh, the good deeds of Avadh.'
Ayodhya Kand.577: Lakshman, Ram, and Sita go to the forest, the outcome will not be good, do not ask. Kaushalya said with a heavy heart, 'I worry about Bharat.'
Ayodhya Kand.578: Is this prayer Asesis for you. Son Devsari the newly married. I did not take Ram on my path. Sitting I tell my friend the truth. Bharats virtues are great, his devotion is trust. Saying Sarada, I ask my mind to be clear. Like an ocean, I am covered by its waves. I always know Bharat as the lamp of his clan. Again and again I say Mahipaa. How can I cross the golden heart? A mans heart is the time to be good. I do not say inappropriate words today. Sorrow and affection are a little gone. Hearing the sweet and pure words. I became the queen of love.
Ayodhya Kand.579: Kausalya says, hear slowly, dear goddess of Mithilesh. You are the embodiment of wisdom, O beloved, you can give advice.
Ayodhya Kand.580: Queen Rani found the right moment. She explained as she saw fit. She wrote and filled with passion. If I do not accept this in my heart, King. Then she carefully considered and weighed. She filled her heart with thoughts and burden. Hidden affection filled her heart. She remained nice, no attachment. She wrote and beautified, heard and simple. Everything became soft, the queen relished. Like raindrops, blessed, blessed sound. Soft affection became established, sage and lover. All residents of Ranis abode wrote and remained. Then slowly, Sumitra said. Goddess Danda, Yama, and Jami passed by. Hearing about Rama, she became delighted.
Ayodhya Kand.581: Quickly placing his feet on the ground, he said with true affection, 'Who will be our helper now, O Mithiles?'
Ayodhya Kand.582: Write in affection, hear in Bineta. Janakpriyas feet, in Punieta. Goddess you are fit, Binay, you are. Dasarathas wife, Rama, the great. Lord, you honor those below. Like smoke from a fire, you bear the head of Agni. Servant, Rau, your actions are your words. Always, Maheswari, Bhavani, be supportive. Your limbs, Rau, are the limbs of the world. Like a lamp, you help in the dark. Rama, go and do the work of the gods. Unshakable, Rau, make Avadhpur your kingdom. Immortal, Naga, Nar, Rama, Bhubali. Find happiness in your own, your own. All this, Rau, is said in wakefulness. Goddess, you are not mute, sages speech.
Ayodhya Kand.583: Tell not the false tale of loves great pain and sorrow. Even love itself went with the false one.
Ayodhya Kand.584: Dear friend, meeting with such beauty is a wonder. Like the sage, the deer, so too Janaki. The tapaswis form was seen, the sweet sorrow of Sita was special. Janak and Ram, the guru, were found. Sita came, Siya was seen. Janak and Janakis form, the blessed sight, the life-giving vision. The body, like water, full of affection. Fear, like the king, mind, like the minister, all were moved. Siyas affection, like a storm, was fierce. Yet, Ram, the life-giver, was gentle. The ever-living sage, in his wisdom, took a child as support. Desire, confusion, intellect, none could resist. The glory of Siya, the love of Raghuvamsha, none can deny.
Ayodhya Kand.585: The affection of father and mother cannot be repaid by a thousand lives. Earthly daughters with patience bear and reflect upon the purification equally.
Ayodhya Kand.586: The sage Janak saw a vision, especially in the auspicious moments of festivals. He purified his lineage, making two virtuous sons. Whose radiance could be compared to the whitest of the white in the world. Like the continuous stream of Surasari, his glory was unbroken. Like the countless eggs of a thousand turtles, his deeds were innumerable. Ganga, the earth, and the sky, these three vast realms, he filled with his virtuous society. He spoke the truth with a pure heart, his mind and soul being the same. Again, he took his mother into his heart, teaching his disciples and benefiting them. He did not keep his mind with his vision, for it was better to stay in the night. The queen Janayu, the princess, wrote with her hand, her words pleasing and beautiful.
Ayodhya Kand.587: Meeting again and again, parting with tears, such is the experience of love. Sometimes the heart is filled with the passage of time, the queen of beauty, in the night of separation.
Ayodhya Kand.588: Hear the behavior of Bharat under Bhupal. His essence is like gold, fragrance, nectar, and essence. His eyes are moist, his body is intoxicated. He is praised beautifully, his heart is delighted. Be careful, listen with a pure face. Bharats story opens the bond of the world. Duty, politics, and divine wisdom are discussed here. My mind understands Bharats greatness. No trick can hide from such wisdom. Ganesha, the remover of obstacles, Siva, Saraswati. Poet, poetician, Budha, Buddha, and Brihaspati. Bharats deeds, glory, and beauty. Morality, manners, virtues, and purity. Understanding, hearing, joy, and all beings. Delight, sweet, and delightful, sweet nectar.
Ayodhya Kand.589: Infinite and matchless is the man, knowing Bharata as equal. How can Sumera or Ser be compared at all in wisdom.
Ayodhya Kand.590: Early in the morning, the sound of birds resounded. Like a dry fish clinging to the earth. Queen heard the boundless glory, but Ram could not express it fully. Filled with love, the queen experienced profound emotions, tasting the joy of life. Many times she tried to describe it, but could not become it. Everything she did was good, pleasing everyones heart. But only Devi filled Raghuvirs life. Love and affection could not be seen or hidden. Filled with affection and tenderness, yet like Ram, within limits. Ultimate joy, true happiness, all are attained. But not like a dream, in reality. I have seen and known, but not like this. True is the path of Rama, touching his feet. I have known and seen, but not like this.
Ayodhya Kand.591: Dawn has broken but I have not seen you, O Ram. I cannot think of love, can only write to Bhoop.
Ayodhya Kand.592: Ram and Bharat recounted virtues with great love. The night passed for the couple as if a blink. The royal assembly woke up at dawn. They bathed and began worshipping the gods. Raghurai went to the guru after bathing. Bowing at his feet, he spoke after receiving permission. 'Lord, Bharat, the townspeople, and mothers are distressed by sorrow and the pain of exile. The king of Mithila, along with his assembly, has been enduring distress for many days. Whatever is appropriate, please do it, Lord. The welfare of all is in your hands.' Saying this, Raghurai became very shy. The sage was thrilled to see his gentle nature. 'Without you, Ram, all comforts and arrangements, both kingdoms are like hell.'
Ayodhya Kand.593: Thou art the bliss of the living, the bliss of life, O Ram. Thou art the knower, the seer, the enjoyer, in the house of those who know as they should.
Ayodhya Kand.594: Who can perform such virtuous deeds, adhere to such duty? Where Rams lotus feet are not. Whoever knows, whoever does not know. Where Rams pure feet are not. You are alone sorrowful, you are alone happy. You know, you live, whatever you choose. When you come, all days are auspicious. With kindness, all paths become beautiful. You reside in hermitages, you bear the burden, you are content, you are a sage. With reverence, you greet Ram, the straight path. Sages, with calm, came to Janak. Ram teaches, guru, king, to listen, kindness, beauty, and affection. Great king, now you should do, with duty, do good to all.
Ayodhya Kand.595: O wise, noble, truthful, righteous, and patient king. Who else is capable of resolving this dilemma in this era without you?
Ayodhya Kand.596: Hear O sage, Janaks affection, written in the way of life and knowledge, renunciation. A faint affection, praising in the mind, came here, not good. Saying Ram is my love, I became a lover. You are dear, your love is flowing. Now we become what we read, increasing joy and wisdom. The sage saw Mahishur, love became a special bond. The king understood and with composure increased wisdom. Bharat came, went ahead, seized the opportunity. Father Bharat said seventeen times Raghu, you are the beloved Raghu.
Ayodhya Kand.597: Rama, true to his vow of truth, was ever righteous and affectionate to all. He bore trials and troubles but said not a word when afflicted.
Ayodhya Kand.598: Hearing this, the body quivered, eyes filled with tears. Spoke slowly, deeply pondering. Lord, beloved, revered father, equal to you. Family guru, equal to benefit, not father. Muni Kausika and others like ministers and sages. Knowledge, like water, is with you now. Servant of children, follower, always obedient. Knowing, I seek to learn from my teacher. This society, understand its depth. Silent, I will speak, outside. Small body, yet great words. Six years old, yet understand many ways. Coming and going, famous old tradition. Duty of service, harsh in this world. Master, duty, self-interest, always in conflict. Hatred, blind, love, not enlightenment.
Ayodhya Kand.599: Keeping Ram, Rukminí, Dharma, and the vow in heart, I know I am dependent. Agreeing with all, I recognize the welfare of everyone.
Ayodhya Kand.600: Subha heard and saw Bharat. He praised the inclusive and harmonious society. Simple yet profound, gentle yet firm, in both softness and hardness. Meaningless and infinite, extremely yet barely. His face, his eyes, his own water. Unable to leave, these extraordinary words. Bhup, Bharat, and the sage together. Where the bewildered and the joyful reign. Hearing and thinking, everyone saw the future. Their minds, like fish in a new pond. The gods first showed the lineage. Seeing the affection, it was special. Bharat saw Ram, full of devotion. The gods were captivated by the melody of the soul. Everyone saw Ram, full of grace. Bhau, incoherent, thought and wrote.
Ayodhya Kand.601: Ram, out of affection and hesitation, said with sorrow, 'O king of gods, create a deception with five elements, otherwise, the work will be ruined.'
Ayodhya Kand.602: Remember Sarada with reverence. O Goddess, see the path of Devi. Again, with intellect, create your own illusion. Deceive and bewilder your clan with tricks. Hearing the bewilderment, the Goddess became silent. She spoke with sweet words, rooted in her essence. I say, let Bharats intellect turn round. Even a thousand eyes cannot fathom Sumera. Indeed, illusion and Maya are heavy. Bharat cannot deceive with intellect, nor can he see clearly. Sarada says, following the path, the world turns. The bewilderment of night is known in the morning. Bharats heart is the abode of Sita and Rama. There, darkness is dispelled by light. Saying this, Sarada went to the path of the world. The bewilderment of night is known in the morning.
Ayodhya Kand.603: The deceitful mind agitates the innocent soul with false promises. Construct the universe with the power of illusion, fear, delusion, and passion.
Ayodhya Kand.604: The king of gods, having done evil, was worried. Bharat would ruin all work. Janak went near Ragunath. The light of the solar dynasty honored everyone. Then the chief priest of the Raghu dynasty spoke, in accordance with time, society, and dharma. He narrated the conversation between Janak and Bharat. He beautifully conveyed Bharat's words, 'O father Ram, whatever command you give, I will do all of it, this is my opinion.' Hearing this, Ragunath, joining both hands, spoke in true, simple, and gentle words, 'O Mithiles, you are present here. My news is good in every way. Whatever your royal command, I will accept it on my head with your oath.'
Ayodhya Kand.605: Ramas path heard by the sage Janak and his court including all the spectators, none could look away from Bharatas face.
Ayodhya Kand.606: Bharat, out of shyness, looked. Ram's brother held great patience. Seeing the flower, he remembered affection. The increasing attachment, like an elephant, was prevented from binding his heart. Sorrow, like a golden-eyed deer, had clouded his mind. Hari's pure virtues are the origin of the world. Bharat's vast wisdom, without effort, saved him at that time. He bowed to everyone with folded hands. He implored Ram, the king, the guru, and the saints. 'Forgive my great impropriety today. I speak harsh words with a gentle face.' Remembering the beautiful Sharada in his heart, she came to his lotus-like mouth from his mind. Pure wisdom, dharma, and justice shone. Bharat's speech was like a beautiful swan.
Ayodhya Kand.607: See with discernment, Bilochen with gentle affection the society. Bowing, he says remembering Raghuraj, the Lord of the Raghus.
Ayodhya Kand.608: Revered Supreme Benefactor Hidden Within. Simple Master Virtue Treasure. Devoted Protector All-Knowing. Utmost Helper Shelter Benefactor. Praises Keeper Of Virtues Blameless. Master Guru Gosain Is Gosai. I Am Like Him I Praise. Lord Father Life Love Stayed. Came Here Society Gathered. World Good Bad High Low. Impermanent Eternal Abode Forget. Rama Is Content Mind Forget. Seen Heard None Else. I Have Done All Ways Devotion. Lord Accepted Devotion Servant.
Ayodhya Kand.609: Please do well my Lord. Pollution be adornment most beautiful and charming.
Ayodhya Kand.610: The song goes in a pleasant manner. The world listens to the melodious words. Deceitful, cunning, wicked, and foolish. Low, dark, blind, and without hope. Hearing this, the assembly came to seek shelter. They offered a single salutation. Seeing the fault, none felt ashamed. Hearing the virtues, they praised the virtuous society. Saying they are servants, they are adorned with all. Ones own actions are not understood in dreams. The servant worries and thinks of himself. Gosain, not another, raised his hand. With a gesture, he wept. The animals dance, the sweet verses are understood. The virtues, the path, the dancers are in the middle of the path.
Ayodhya Kand.611: Thus the sun of reform has risen on the people. None can flourish without mercy, in the garden of compassion.
Ayodhya Kand.612: I think it is a morning prayer. The king comes to greet. Then the kola nut is offered to the deity. Every morning I hope for a good day. Seeing the auspicious beginning, I pray for natural ease. Understanding the situation, I seek the masters favor. The masters grace and blessings are supreme. You have kept me safe, O god, in your embrace. In your mercy, you have done well. I fell, but you lifted me. O master, you are understood in your own way. Inexpressible and unspoken, the essence of devotion. I offer my utmost devotion and reverence.
Ayodhya Kand.613: A true friend, wise Sir, has many stories to tell. I came to teach God, now all is changed in me.
Ayodhya Kand.614: Lord Padma Pargha doha. Truthful virtue brings joy and is loved. Thus I speak of my Lord. Interest is awake while sleeping in dreams. Natural affection serves the master. Four evils are forsaken for self-interest, deceit, and fruit. Equal service to the Lord is not a master. By His grace, devotees receive divine favor. Thus filled with love, I sit near the Lords feet. Hearing with devotion, affection grows in the assembly of Raghuram.
Ayodhya Kand.615: Raghurau has slight affection for the good society, a wise monk, and a wealthy Mithila. The glory of Bhayaps devotion, Bharatis praise, and Manass adornment is immense. Bharati presides, making the bewildered rain fragrant flowers, cleansing the mind. Tulsi listens to all, and the nectar of Nisagrams songs quivers.
Ayodhya Kand.616: Seeing the sorrowful poor in the unfortunate society, men and women. Magha greatly despondent, killing himself in hope of auspiciousness.
Ayodhya Kand.617: Deceitful and cunning is the false king. But honest work is dear to the true king. True and false are the same by nature. Deceit does not appear as such. First, with cleverness, he devises deceit. Then, he breaks it, and all agree. Women are fascinated by everyone. But love for Rama remains intense. Fear is broken, and the heart is calm. I become charming, and my body is delightful. The mind is in doubt, causing the people sorrow. Like the confluence of the two rivers, it happens once. But in joy, none are disgraced. In one life, none perish. Writing with wit, I say to the kind lord. The rich and the noble, the eloquent.
Ayodhya Kand.618: Bharat, Janak, the sages, the ministers, and the saints woke up at dawn. The divine illusion affected everyone according to their worth.
Ayodhya Kand.619: Kripasindhu wrote with sorrowful words. His own affectionate lord, the charming trickster. Meeting the assembly, the bull among gurus, minister of the great fish. Bharat protected the nation, every soul was his minister. Rama painted the picture, taught to speak and learn to write. Bharats affection, humility, and grandeur. Listening was bliss, speaking was hardship. Coming to see, Bharats devotion, Mithileshs love, and the sages joy. Praising Tulsi, saying how great devotion and wisdom are. You are small, the greatness is known. Kabikuls words are known, Sakus joy is known. Unable to say more of praise and charm, wisdom and the way of life are not enough.
Ayodhya Kand.620: Bharat's pure fame is like the pure moon, and his good intellect is like the Chakor princess. When the pure moon rises, people's hearts and the sky become one, looking at it.
Ayodhya Kand.621: Bharat's auspicious nature is not easy to fathom. O poet, forgive my small intellect and fickleness. Hearing this, Sita's eyebrows furrowed regarding Bharat. She thought, "May I not be devoted to Ram's feet." Remembering Bharat, Ram's love for him, to whom it is easy, to him it is like a bamboo. The compassionate one saw the condition of all. Ram, the wise, knew the hearts of the people. The upholder of dharma, patient, a city of justice, a mountain of truth and affection, an ocean of happiness. Understanding the time, place, and occasion, Raghuraj, the protector of policy and love. Spoke words that were the essence of speech, beneficial in outcome, sweet like the moon's nectar to hear. "Dear Bharat, you are the upholder of dharma, known in the world and Vedas for your love."
Ayodhya Kand.622: By deed, word, and mind, you are pure, like yourself, dear one. How can the virtues of a younger brother, understood by the guru, be described like flowers?
Ayodhya Kand.623: True is the way of the lineage and tradition. Truthful oaths bring joy in honor. Equal is the shame of society towards gurus. Depressed is the mind of one who is indifferent to benefit and harm. You alone perform all actions with virtue. You bear the supreme benefit and duty. I trust you in all ways. Yet, I say as per the opportunity. Without you, there is no conversation. Only the grace of the gurus abode is sufficient. Subjects, friends, and families are all included in the good. Without opportunity or time, the world cannot say anything. Thus, the sage Mithilesh has composed this as per the way.
Ayodhya Kand.624: Kings work is all glory, husbands duty is righteousness, earth is wealth, home is peace. Gurus light gives us goodness every day, may the result be good.
Ayodhya Kand.625: With society, it is our own. Home is where blessings are stored. Mother, father, guru, and master direct. All religions are borne by the earth. So you do and we do as we are guided. Like a guardian, you are both protector and companion. A sage gives a complete path. Honor, prosperity, and blessed are the gifts. So consider and truly heavy are the trials. You do and we do as we are happy. Sharing misfortune, I am your brother every morning. You bear the difficult times for a long duration. Knowing you, I say soft yet firm. In good times, it is not inappropriate. How can I leave you, dear friend? I cannot bear to see you suffer.
Ayodhya Kand.626: The servants face shines like the moon after getting a new job. Hearing Tulsis way of affection, Sukhdev praises him.
Ayodhya Kand.627: All listened to Raghubers words. Love surrounded the silent ones. A calm society in affectionate meditation. Seeing this, Das Chup Sard Sadhi. Bharatbhayu, supreme satisfaction. Facing the Lord, no sorrow. Face pleased, mind relieved of sorrow. Bhagwans grace, Janu sang. With great love, I bow to unmeasured affection. Said with force, Pankhru. Lord, in fear, came for happiness. With a flame, I became a part of this world. Now, if Kindness comes to stay. I will wear a garland, dressed properly. I will rely on Dev, he will enchant me. Cross the time, I will find what is meant.
Ayodhya Kand.628: God anointing is beneficial for all, guided by sacred rules and instructions. When you come, all holy places and waters shall be pleasing.
Ayodhya Kand.629: Ones wish is a great fortune. Fear does not come when you know. Said the father, the Lord came to see. Spoke of love, the beloved is dear. Chitrakoot, the land of images, became a pilgrimage. Birds and animals, the mountains gushed with life. The Lords feet were marked on the special earth. When he came, I saw him. When the sage sat, he came to rest. The father, gone from fear, roamed the forest. The sage, blessed by the sage, became a bringer of good fortune. The pure, beloved brother, a purifier and lover. Where the sages came to reside, They kept the pilgrimage waters and land. Hearing the Lord, the life was filled with joy. The sages feet were pleased, his head bowed in delight.
Ayodhya Kand.630: Bharat and Ram have the connection of all auspicious roots. His speech is melodious like the sound of flowers.
Ayodhya Kand.631: Blessed Bharat, Jaya Ram Gosain. Dev says he is pleased with barley. Muni is loved in Mithileshs assembly. Bharat, hearing of his safety, was filled with fear. Bharat, the virtues of Ram, are loved. Pulaki is pleased, and he smiles at Bidhi. Servant, master, are loved and cherished. Nemu and pemu are extremely delightful. According to wisdom, they are praised. Secretary, and all members of the assembly, have affection. Hearing, hearing, Ram and Bharats news. The society, with their hearts, is pleased and saddened. Ram knows both pain and pleasure equally. Saying the virtues of Ram, Rani was awakened. One says, Raghubir is great. One praises Bharat, considering him good.
Ayodhya Kand.632: Atri said then Bharat saw the holy and unblemished Tīrtha nearby.
Ayodhya Kand.633: Bharat Atres rule ended. He led all to the water ritual. His nephew Aapu Atre, the sage and saint. Together they sang a holy song. The wind god kept the pure path. Atre spoke with great joy and love. This place is eternal, its holiness unending. Since then, devotees have seen its beauty. They find it sweet, a source of comfort. The wind god stayed, bringing benefits to all. He found the easiest and most difficult aspects of dharma. Now people in Bharat speak of this. The wind gods sacred place, a water ritual. Love and devotion have immersed the beings. They are now pure.
Ayodhya Kand.634: Though the glory of Raghurau is great, the Lord is even more illustrious. He is the sovereign of the holy places of Raghuvansi.
Ayodhya Kand.635: Dharma speaks with the enthusiasm of history. Fearful nights pass as sweet mornings. Always clean, Bharat with two brothers. Ram and Atri, their guru, found them. Together, the society arranges everything. Ram goes, becoming ten soldiers. Soft steps walk without hesitation. I become gentle, the soft earth, secretly pleased. Sharp thorns, harsh blows, are evil. Men are gentle, soft paths are made. Flowers bloom, fruits ripen, grass is tender. Animals look, birds speak sweetly. All serve, Ram is dear to everyone.
Ayodhya Kand.636: Easy solution is that Rama says all is natural. Rama says life is dear to Bharat; how can this be a great matter.
Ayodhya Kand.637: This way he roams and wanders for many years. The sage recites the name of love and devotion. The land is a place of merit. The birds, animals, trees, and grass form a garden. Beautiful, unique, and sacred, everything is seen with wonder. The sage, delighted in his heart, speaks: The name, virtues, and merit are powerful. Some immerse, some bow. Some look, some are delighted in their hearts. Some sit and the sage sees them. Seeing, he serves with affection and care. Asīs becomes delighted and a deity. Then they return, the day passes. The Lord looks from the lotus feet.
Ayodhya Kand.638: I saw the Thirtha tank full on all five days. Saying and hearing Hari, the days turned into evenings.
Ayodhya Kand.639: Morning prayer is simple and pure. Bharat, the land, is blessed with thirteen rulers. A good day is known by the heart. Ram says with compassion. Gur Narp Bharat observes the assembly. Ram is seen again in the world. The assembly is held, everyone thinks. I do not say Ram is without a master. Bharat sees Rams silence. Rising with love, he acts with care. Bowing, he says with force. The Lord keeps all pleasures. I am attached, suffering every morning. Many times I have felt pain. Now, saint, you give me devotion. I spend my life in service.
Ayodhya Kand.640: When again the means are found and the poor are seen, then the Sikhs bestow kindness as Cosalpal and Kripal do.
Ayodhya Kand.641: Citizens, family, subjects, O Lord. All are pure, fresh, and related. Your great goodness burns away the sorrow of existence. Without the Lord, the attainment of the supreme state is in vain. The wise Lord knows everyone's desires, longings, and the state of their hearts. The protector of the surrendered will protect everyone. May he sustain both sides. I have great faith in this in every way. Having considered, the worry is intense. My distress, O Lord, and your affection, both together have made me stubborn. Remove this fault, O Lord.
Ayodhya Kand.642: Hearing the words of his brother, the friend of the distressed, Ram, the Lord, spoke appropriately to the time and place.
Ayodhya Kand.643: You are my friend, Parijan. Worry is like a prison for kings and queens. On my head, the guru is like a Muni of Mithilesh. We are your dreams, not illusions. You are my supreme goal, the ultimate purpose. In truth, you are the sustainer, the best king, and the best. The guru, father, mother, master, and teacher are all caretakers. We walk on the path, not wandering. Without thinking, we consider everything. Caring for a lifetime. The land, friends, and family are all related. The gurus place is like a home with a burden. You are the Muni, mother, minister, and teacher. You care for all, the capital, and the people.
Ayodhya Kand.644: The leader should desire only what is necessary for food and drink. Care for health and nourishment for all parts of the body, including the tulsi plant, with discernment.
Ayodhya Kand.645: The law is supreme, all must obey it. As my heart desires, so my mind yearns. Friends, awaken them in many ways. Without a foundation, the mind cannot rest. Bharat, Sheel, Guru, Sachiv, Samaj, Sukh, Bibas, Raghuraj, Lord, by His grace, Bharat and Sheel embraced. The seat of compassion, the treasury of tears, the people and life. Bharat, the treasure of love, the end, life and effort. Closing the gates, doing good deeds. Pure eyes, service, purification. Bharat, content, relying on, no joy like Rama.
Ayodhya Kand.646: He asked for leave, bowed, and Ram embraced him. The people were agitated, and Amarapati found a crooked, bad opportunity.
Ayodhya Kand.647: He who is adorned with beauty, may he be everywhere kind. Life is a journey to live it well. The beauty of love is like a flower in full bloom. God punishes all people with illness. By the grace of Rama, one is transformed. Doubts are dispelled, becoming a singer of virtues. Meeting brothers fills the heart with brothers. Speaking of the love of Rama, one does not hesitate. Body and mind are preserved with affection. Steadfast, brave, and patient, one gives up everything. Bright eyes blink in joy. Seeing the assembly of gods and demons, sorrow arises. Saints and gurus, patient Janak, teach with wisdom. Those who are pure and silent, like a lotus in water, are like gold in the heart.
Ayodhya Kand.648: Seeing you, Raghubar and Bharat's love and joy were boundless. Their minds, bodies, and words became absorbed in detachment and contemplation.
Ayodhya Kand.649: Where Janak is guru, wisdom and dawn. Natures affection says, This is the best. Barun, Raghubar, and Bharat, the three, are filled with joy. Hearing the harsh words of a poet, one understands. So, the essence of sorrow, the unspeakable beauty. Equally, the affection, remembering the sorrow. Bharat meets Raghubar, explaining. Again, the enemys forest, causing joy, disturbing the heart. Servant and minister, Bharat finds peace. Each does their own work. Hearing the severe sorrow of the society, they prepare to leave. Lord Padum, the two brothers, bound. They go, supported by their breath, as Rama and Sita. Muni, Tapas, become gods. All are honored, flourishing, blooming.
Ayodhya Kand.650: Embracing Lakshman, bowing, and placing the dust of Sita's feet on his head, he departed with supreme blessings, the root of all auspiciousness.
Ayodhya Kand.651: Ram, with his younger brother, bowed his head to the king. He offered many kinds of humble praises. "O gods, due to your mercy, I suffered much. With the entire community, I came to the forest. Placing his foot in the city, he gave blessings. The king departed with patience. Munis, great gods, and sadhus were honored. They were bid farewell, knowing them to be like Hari. The two brothers went near their mothers-in-law. They returned after bowing at their feet and receiving blessings. Kausik, Vamadeva, Jabali, citizens, family, and good ministers. Ram, with his younger brother, bid farewell to all, offering appropriate humility and salutations. Women, men, young, middle, old."
Ayodhya Kand.653: Sita met her mother and father. Then, the beloved love was renewed. Bowing to meet everyone, the poet said she would not forget this love. Hearing this, everyone was pleased and the love remained within her. Raghupati arranged a palanquin for her. He woke up everyone and helped her climb. Over and over, she met and hugged her mother. With the same affection, the mother arrived. Various jewels, weapons, and elephants were brought. Bharat, the king, and his army came. Heart and soul were with Rama and Sita. Everyone else fell asleep. With her mother and the animals, she went. In the dream, her mind was troubled.
Ayodhya Kand.654: The Lord, with Sita and Lakshman, bowed at the feet of the revered Guru. They returned to their leaf hut, filled with joy and wonder.
Ayodhya Kand.655: Farewell, O fair Nishad. My heart wanders with a great sorrow, a deep melancholy. A hunter, a tailor, a fowler. Circled, circled, the hunter. Lord Shyam, Lakhna, seated, longing for a companion. Beloved, friend, in separation, written in sorrow. Bharat, full of affection, beautiful, fair. Beloved, younger brother, saying, I will tell. Love, appearance, to be preserved in the heart. The face of Lord Rama, love dwelling. Thus, opportunity, bird, fish, water. Chitrakut, moving, immovable, worn out. Bewildered, looking, Dasarathas. Saying, The flower blossoms, the home is reached. Lord, bowing, placing trust. Joyful, mind wandering, not afraid.
Ayodhya Kand.656: With Anuj Sij among the Lord Rajats household. Devotion knowledge renunciation dwell in the body.
Ayodhya Kand.657: Munis, Brahmins, Guru, Bharat, and the king. All were distressed by the separation from Ram. Counting the Lord's virtues in their minds, all walked silently on the path. Everyone crossed the Yamuna. That day passed without food. They crossed the Devasari and stayed for the second night. Ram's friends made all arrangements. They crossed the Gomti and bathed. On the fourth day, they arrived in Ayodhyapur. Janak stayed in the city for four days. He managed all the royal affairs. Entrusting the ministers, Guru, and Bharat, he departed for Terahuti.
Ayodhya Kand.658: Rama, seeing his darshan, all people perform rites and put on fine clothes. Ornament by ornament, they enjoy happiness and the duration of their life.
Ayodhya Kand.659: Bharat, the swift and good servant, was enlightened. He received instructions for his own work. Then he gave instructions, speaking to his younger brothers. He gave good service to all mothers. Bharat, with folded hands, called the Brahmins. He bowed and humbly requested. "High or low, good or bad work, give me orders without hesitation." He spoke to his family, citizens, and subjects. "Live peacefully and contentedly." With his younger brothers, he returned to the Guru's house. He prostrated himself and said with folded hands, "May it be so, remain restrained." The Muni, with a body thrilled with love, said, "Whatever you do, that will be the essence of dharma in the world."
Ayodhya Kand.660: Hearing the Sikhs praise Akhisars great valor, the Lord sat on the throne barefoot without hesitation.
Ayodhya Kand.661: Ram bowed his head at the Guru's feet. He received permission from the Lord's feet. He made Nandigram his leaf hut. The patient upholder of dharma made his residence there. With matted locks on his head, like a sage, he slept on the ground on a bed of kusha grass. He observed strict vows and rules regarding food and clothing. He lovingly performed difficult ascetic dharma. He completely abandoned ornaments, clothes, and abundant pleasures of enjoyment, in mind, body, and speech. The kingdom of Ayodhya shone like a good kingdom. Hearing of Dasharath's wealth, Dhanad was ashamed. Bharat lived in that city without attachment, like a bee in a champak garden. Ram's beloved, Lakshmi's abode, abandoning.
Ayodhya Kand.662: Ram does not perform the first bhajan after Bharat. The Chatak and swan praise the tank of Viveka's glory.
Ayodhya Kand.663: Body days pass day dawn comes. Flame bright power face shines. Always new Ram love drink. Increase duty group mind not lazy. Like water mixed dense light. Sprout sit baby grow. Balance calm harmony rule worship. Nails fill soul pure sky. Pole faith duration life. Master beauty prosperity grown. Ram love done rightly faultless. With society soh always see. Fill understand do good. Devotion patient virtues pure. Born all sweet desire none. Ses Ganesh fall play none.
Ayodhya Kand.664: Always worship the Lord with devotion and do not diminish the heart. Begging, begging he came to do the kings work in many ways.

Aranya Kand.1: Beyond the ocean of delusion, the pure moon of joy, the lotus of dispassion, the remover of heat and suffering, the remover of heat: I bow to Shankar, the embodiment of the Brahmin lineage, the remover of blemishes, dear to Sri Rama. The sweet nectar of bliss, the golden form, the beautiful pair, the bow and arrow, the burden of the bowstring, the best, with eyes like the pupils of a deer, adorned with a tied and short matted hair, accompanied by Lakshmana, having arrived on the path, I sing of the beautiful Rama.
Aranya Kand.2: O Ram, the virtues of the learned and sages are praised. Those deluded by attachment, who are averse to Hari and not devoted to dharma, are not praised.
Aranya Kand.3: The hero Bharati preetee I sang. Mati anurup anup suhaee. Now listen to the Lords deeds very sweet. Doing deeds becoming a divine man, god, and sage. Once choosing flowers to please. Wearing himself as adornment, he became Ram. Sita adorned herself respectfully for the Lord. Seated, breaking the stone, he became beautiful. Lord of the gods, taking his son, he put on a warriors attire. With a fierce look, Raghupati showed his strength. Like a pipilika in the sea, with great patience, he desired. Sita, in her steps, was stunned and ran away. Foolish, with poor patience, she caused trouble. Raghunayak, flowing with blood, went. Drawing the bow, searching for the arrow.
Aranya Kand.4: Extremely merciful Lord Raghunath always showers on the poor with grace. Yet some foolish and wicked ones remain ungrateful.
Aranya Kand.5: Inspired mantra Brahmasara Dhava. Come, I have seen fear. Hold your own form, yet see. Ram kept away from me, yet not. Felt disappointed, mind filled with fear. Like a wheel, fear, a terrible madness. Brahmashila, Shivas abode, all people. Rotated, tired, frightened, we wept. None sat, could not say no. Held, Ram, the enemy, did not win. Mother and death, same to him. Poison became nectar, heard Haris name. Made friend, truth, enemy, to do. Where, bewildered, Vindu, river, sat. All the world, only fire, that fire. Who, Raghuvir, turned away, heard brother. Narada saw Jayant, at night. With kind, soft heart, Sant. Immediately called Ram, came, called, saw, pleased.
Aranya Kand.6: Even though love is just a crime, it is fitting to bear it. O Raghuvir, show your mercy by sparing me.
Aranya Kand.7: Raghupati resided in Chitrakoot, performing various deeds like nectar for the ears. Then Ram thought in his mind, "Everyone will know about me here." Taking leave from all the sages, both brothers, along with Sita, departed. When the Lord went to Atri's hermitage, the great sage became joyful upon hearing this. Atri, with a thrilled body, ran out. Seeing Ram, he came forward with great eagerness. Ram bowed, and the sage embraced him, bathing him with tears of love. Seeing Ram's beauty, his eyes were cooled. Then he respectfully brought them to his hermitage. After performing worship and speaking pleasant words, he offered roots and fruits pleasing to the Lord's mind.
Aranya Kand.8: The Lords throne is filled with the gaze of beautiful eyes. The sage speaks highly of the supreme and highly enlightened one.
Aranya Kand.9: I bow to the affectionate devotee. I sing of Your lotus feet, the abode of kindness and compassion. Black and beautiful, O Lord, You are the mountain of Ambubhavi. Your eyes are like fully bloomed kumkuma flowers, forgiving all faults. Your long-armed are full of valor, O Lord, You are the incomprehensible opulence. Your bow is like a nishan, You are the master of the three worlds
Aranya Kand.10: With humility the sage spoke, nodding his head with force. O Lord of Charn and Saroruh, how often have I lost my mind.
Aranya Kand.11: Seeta, seated on a mat, is lovely. Bihari Sushila, her younger sister, is charming. Rishipatinee brings joy to the mind. Aashi embraces her closely. Her attire is adorned with precious jewelry, always wearing new and fragrant garlands. The sages wife speaks gently, her words like a soft breeze. Mothers
Aranya Kand.12: Natural purification is when a woman serves her husband with good speed. As she sings, the sound of Tulsi and Hari is heard everywhere. Listen, O Sita, to your name, remembered by a faithful wife. I will tell the story of your beloved Rama, which is beneficial to the world.
Aranya Kand.13: Hearing Janaki, param sukha was obtained. With head bowed, she was called Charni. Then the sage said to Kripa Nidhan, I have become old, its time to leave. Continuously, I seek your grace. Knowing the servant, you grant the devotee. Dharma is firm, as per the Lords words. Hearing supreme love, the sage understood. With grace, you are like Aj and Sankhadevi. You are Ram, affectionate and gentle. You are friend to the poor, soft in nature. Now I know, I am Chaturai. I sing to you, all gods. None is equal to you, no bond can hold you. I can say in some way, now Master. You are the Inner Guide, Lord. Saying this, the Lord looked at the sage calmly, his eyes filled with tears, body quivering.
Aranya Kand.14: My heart leaps in love, eyes filled with beauty. Mind immersed in knowledge, virtues, beyond the lord, I see, meditate, endure. Meditation, yoga, religion, these bring man unmatched devotion. Radhakrishnas life, recited night and day, by Tulsidas.
Aranya Kand.15: Ram's good fame is the root of happiness, it calms sins and controls the mind. Those who listen to it respectfully, Ram remains favorable to them. In this age of Kali, there is no dharma, knowledge, yoga, or chanting. Those clever people who abandon all other hopes and worship Ram.
Aranya Kand.16: Bowing his head at the lotus feet of the sage, the Lord of gods, humans, and sages went to the forest. Ram was ahead, and his younger brother Lakshman was behind. Kishkindha Kand.1: Beautiful and charming to both the senses and the intellect, the cow and the bull are endowed with great beauty and are providers of prosperity and are heard as the reciters of the glories of Govinda and the cows of the Vraja. They are always eager to please and are the givers of devotion. Emerging from the ocean of brahman, the original and eternal, the Lord, in the form of a cowherd boy, is ever charming and beautiful, surrounded by the cows and cowherd boys. The cows and cowherd boys drink the nectar of the name of Sri Rama, which is the essence of all that is sweet, auspicious, and eternal in the ocean of samsara.
Kishkindha Kand.2: Freedom is known at birth with knowledge and no loss in the place where Sambhu resides, that is Kashi indeed. All the angels and groups of gods tremble before him who drank the poison. Thou dost not sing with a mind slow or with a compassionate heart, Sankarshana.
Kishkindha Kand.3: Rahi with Raghuraayaa beyond Rishymukh mountain. Sugreevaa with minister stayed there. Seeing him, Hanumaaan praised his unparalleled strength. He said, Listen, Hanumaaan speaks of the couple of manly strength. Holding his form, he went away. Knowing the way, he broke the mountain. Think of Bali in your mind. Run away immediately, leave this place. With Bheema, the monkey went there. Without a head, he asked, why are you here. You are dark and fair in body. You take the form of a hero again. You walk on hard ground as if it were soft. For what reason do you wander as your master. You sing sweetly, charming, beautiful. You speak harshly, burning with passion. You are three gods, none like you. You are both man and Narayana.
Kishkindha Kand.4: World's savior, destroyer of birth and death, remover of Earth's burden. Yet You, Lord of all universes, take human incarnation.
Kishkindha Kand.5: Kosales went to Dasarathas place. We became his sons, valuing our life. Name Rama Lakshman, twins brothers. Company of women, fair and lovely. Here, Hari Nischar, the beautiful. Bhrigu left us, searching for us. You narrated your charit, we sang. Bhrigu understood his own story. Lord recognized himself, continued his devotion. Joy filled his heart, his master. I asked the parrot, who is your master. Your illusion, I forgot, so I did not recognize the Lord.
Kishkindha Kand.6: One I am a faint devotee with a humble heart, devoid of knowledge. But Lord, I forget you, O friend, Lord.
Kishkindha Kand.7: Even though the Lord has many flaws, the servant sees only his glory. O Lord, you have entranced my life with your illusion; yet you have spared me and shown me favor. But I, Raghuvir, recite this doha. I do not know any other form of devotion. A servant, son, husband, and father—these are my only trust. I remain without sorrow, becoming the Lords comfort. Saying this, I weep in anguish, as my heart is filled with affection for my own body. Then Raghupati arose and embraced me, moistening my eyes with his own tears. I hear the monkey Jai and the sage Mani have met; they are my beloved Lachman and his counterpart. A person of equal vision can say this to everyone: the servant is unique, the beloved is irreplaceable.
Kishkindha Kand.8: So unique is his mind that Hanuman does not falter. I am the eternal servant and master Bhagvant.
Kishkindha Kand.9: Seeing Pavans son, Pati Anukula, the heart joyfully danced with every step. Lord Sail remained as the monkey king. He was Sugriva, your servant. Thus, the Lord created Maya. He gave protection to the weak and dispelled fear. So Sita was sought after. Wherever she was, thousands of arrows were shot. In this manner, the whole story was explained. Taking the two worlds, He ascended the throne. When Sugriva saw Rama, he considered himself born again with great fortune. Not meeting the feet, he embraced Rama along with his brother. Thinking thus, the monkey king considered this method. He did this with the intention of winning the heart.
Kishkindha Kand.10: Then Hanuman narrated the entire story of both sides. With the strength of the faithful narrator, he strengthened his resolve.
Kishkindha Kand.12: Friend hearing this became very happy and saluted Rama. For whom should I say this, oh Sugriva.
Kishkindha Kand.13: Bali and I, we were two brothers. Our love was such that it cannot be described. There was a demon named Mayavi. He came to our village, O Lord. At midnight, he called out at the city gate. Bali could not tolerate the enemy's strength. Bali ran, seeing him flee. I also went along with my brother. He entered a mountain cave. Then Bali explained to me. "Wait for me for a fortnight. If I don't come out, know that I am dead." I waited there for a month, O enemy. A stream of blood flowed out from there. Bali killed him and came out. He placed a stone there and left.
Kishkindha Kand.14: Listen, Sugreeva, you have killed Bali, alone the vanara. Bramha and Rudra sought shelter, but could not save themselves.
Kishkindha Kand.16: Tell me, O dear friend Raghunath, listen to Bali. Even if I am charmed, I will become Sanath again.
Kishkindha Kand.17: Let me translate this as you asked: The great egoistic went with pride. Sugriva was known as thin as grass. Then Balí with very fair skin. With a slap he roared like a thunder. Then Sugriva became frightened and ran away. A punch seemed like a thunder to me. I who spoke to Raghuvíras kindness. No friend became for me this black one. You two are of the same form brothers. Such illusion does not deceive me. He touched Sugrivas body. The body seemed like a curtain to all elders. He put a garland of flowers around his neck. Again gave him strength to stand up. Again became various times a wife. Saw Raghurámas feet and touched them.
Kishkindha Kand.18: With many tricks and strength, Sugriva feared Hanumans victory. Then Ram killed Bali, my hearts beat stopped.
Kishkindha Kand.19: Early morning the devotee stood facing the Lord. Again rising and sitting, the Lord appeared before him. Wearing saffron, he tied his hair in a knot. With eyes like arun, he raised his head. Again and again, he meditated and expressed his devotion. The Lord promised a fruit-bearing birth. His heart filled with love, his face remained firm. Speaking, he turned towards Rama. Goswami descended for the sake of dharma. He fought and cured the disease of passion. I am Sugriva, my brother, wife, sister, and daughter. Hear me, O capable daughter, they are equal. I saw these as impure, yet no sin arose. I was proud, excessively arrogant. You taught women, but did not teach me. I relied on my strength, and fought the lowly arrogant.
Kishkindha Kand.20: Listen, O Ram Swami, I am not a fool. The Lord is ever merciful to me; at the end of my life, He will save me.
Kishkindha Kand.21: Hearing Ram's very gentle words, Bali touched his head with his own hand. "Make my body immortal, save my life." Bali said, "Listen, O treasure of mercy. People strive for many births, but in the end, they cannot utter Ram's name. Whose name's power makes Shankar happy, and grants eternal salvation to all equally. That very one has come within my sight. Will such a Lord ever appear again?"
Kishkindha Kand.22: So those eyes have gazed and the Vedas sang, saying, He who meditates, the wind subdues the mind. But the sage could not find peace of mind. I know pride dwells in me, so I say to the Lord, Keep my body. Why should I cut off my face and become a barber? Now show me mercy, Lord, and look upon me, so I may ask for you. My life and actions are rooted in the love of Ramas feet. This child is like my own, without any enmity, a boon-giving Lord. Hold me with your hand, for neither gods nor men are worthy of you as a servant and Angad.
Kishkindha Kand.23: Rama with firm affection took Balis body in his hands. Sumana Mal like a garland on the neck he did not let go.
Kishkindha Kand.24: Ram Bali went to his own abode. The city people ran in panic. Tending to various laments, the stars released the case and did not tighten it. Tending to the case, Tara saw Raghuraja. He knew Hari and his Maya. Like a flame in water, smoke in the sky, a very lowly body crafted by five elements. Manifest in the body, you stood in front of me. Life is eternal, somehow attached to you. The fruit of knowledge and practice became evident. With this, supreme devotion was sought. Uma was heated and dried by her. She danced in the morning, Ram Goswami. Then Sugriva came here. He performed all the duties as per the rules. Ram told his brother to understand. Kishkindha Kand.25: Lachman at once spoke to Purjan Bipra Samaj. Raja is where Sugreev and Angad and Jubaraj.
