Sugriv made him his king. Raghubir's nature is very compassionate. Knowing such a Lord, if one abandons Him, how can one not fall into the water of calamity? Then he called Sugriv again. He taught him many kinds of statecraft. The Lord said, "Listen, Sugriv, be happy. I will not go to the city for fourteen years. The summer and rainy seasons have arrived. Stay near the shade of the Sal tree. You, along with Angad, rule."
Kishkindha Kand.27: He adorned the first Devanhas mountain cave beautifully. Ram Kripaṇidhi will stay for some days and come.
Kishkindha Kand.28: Beautiful blooming surpassing beauty. Resonating with honey, the love for honey. Roots, fruits, leaves pleasing. Became many when the Lord came. Seeing charming unblemished saal. Suraapu stayed there with his brother. Deva took the form of a bee, a bird, an animal. Performing the service of a sage, a saint. Forming a auspicious form then. Dwelling there, Lord Ramas abode then. Splitting the stone, extremely white pleasing. Reclining in happiness, two brothers there. Anuj spoke many stories then. Devotion, patience, politics, discernment. Rain season clouds shading the sky. Trembling, it seemed very pleasing.
Kishkindha Kand.29: Lakshman, look at the peacocks dancing, seeing the clouds. Just as a devotee of Vishnu rejoices, seeing a renunciate devoted to Hari.
Kishkindha Kand.30: Thunder rumbles in the sky, a terrible roar. My heart is afraid of a beloved lost. The damsel trembles, yet does not remain hidden. Love is not found where jesting is. Rain falls quickly, wetting the land. As new buds receive knowledge, so do we. Drops endure falling, like mountains standing still. Scanty streams fill the torai, as little wealth remains with others. The earth is covered by water, life is entangled in illusion. Bowl after bowl is filled with water, as good qualities are adorned by virtuous people. Stream of water flows, becoming a great river. It becomes unshakable, like the eternal soul.
Kishkindha Kand.31: Green land covered with grass is not a path. Like factions after a battle become hidden in the true scripture.

Kishkindha Kand.33: In many places, the strong wind brings clouds everywhere. Like the fruits of a thief, the result of unrighteous deeds cannot be hidden. In many places, the day is dark, in many places the butterflies are revealed. Like the fruit of unripe fruit, the result of unripe knowledge cannot be good.
Kishkindha Kand.34: The rain has brought an end to the autumn season. Lakhman saw his beloved param. Flowers withered, all men grew old. Janu showed the result of the rain, revealing matured wisdom. August arose, its path dried out. As with greed, contentment is its drying. Streams of pure water delighted the heart. A devotees heart, intoxicated by bliss. The juice of the root, water of the stream. A renunciate gives up attachment like a wise one. Knowing the autumn has come, I see the right time as beneficial. The earth does not blush, as the wise do work. Water is restrained, I am like the childless. Without wealth, pure is the sky. A devotee, remove all hopes. Sometimes I say the rain, Sāradī, was slight. Sometimes one feather of devotion, like a sparrow.
Kishkindha Kand.35: Let us sing of Harisi, the king who became a tapaswi (meditator), banik (a title for a wealthy person), and bhikari (beggar). As he received the blessings of Hari (God), his labor became four ashramas (stages of life).
Kishkindha Kand.36: Happy are those who are deep like water. Like Him, their refuge, there is no obstacle. Flowers and lotuses bloom like the sky. The formless Brahman becomes formful like that. The humming bee is beautiful like the unblemished. The beautiful bird and the sun display various forms. The mind is free from sorrow like a chakravaka bird at night. Like a wealthy person seeing a sinner. Crying and thirsting, it is intense. Like one who does not enjoy happiness due to not being a sinner. Heat and night steal the season of autumn. The sight of a saint is like a sinners fall. Seeing the moon and the parrot, the world is filled. Thinking, like a devotee seeing Hari. Fear and shame pass like ice and fear. Like a twice-born person committing a sin, the clans destruction.

If I say Uma, what dream is this. The sage knows this character. Those who believe Raghubirs recitation. Lakshman, the angry lord, is known. He climbed the bow, shot the arrow.

Climbing the mountain peak, he saw before him. The earth seemed to smile, a delightful sight. Cuckoos, cranes, and swans flew overhead. Many birds chirped in joy. Remember me, do not fear." Hearing these words, the monkeys, overwhelmed with love, spoke respectfully with folded hands, "Lord, whatever you say suits you. Hearing our words, you are enchanted. Knowing us as poor monkeys."
Lanka Kand.269: The Lord inspired Hanuman, the excellent monkey, keeping all as Ramas form on his body. With joy and sorrow, he went without care, speaking in various ways. The monkey king, Nila, Angad, Nala, Hanuman. Along with Vibhishana, the other group of powerful monkeys. He cannot hold any love, his eyes filled with tears. Looking directly at Rama, his body did not blink.
Lanka Kand.270: With great affection, Raghuраy is seen. He makes all the flights ascend. O Bipra Charansir, I will play the flute. Seeing the northern direction, I will blow the flute. The flight becomes noisy while moving. Victory to Raghubир, said everyone. The throne is very attractive. Lord is seated on it with glory. Rama and Bhamini, along with the golden Meru peaks. The colorful flight moves with great enthusiasm. Like a shower of sweet flowers, the music delights. The supreme blissful flight, tri-colored, moves. Like the clear water of the ocean, it is pure. Becoming beautiful, I stand here. My heart is pleased and clear like the sky. Saying Raghubир, I see Sita. Lakshman is here, Indrajit is defeated. Hanuman and Angad defeated the demons. Sita is above all, the heavy Nisachar is defeated. Kumbhakarna and
Lanka Kand.271: Here the bridge was built and the place became a source of happiness. With Sita, Kripa Nidhi paid respects to Lord Sambhu. Wherever the ocean of mercy was created, there was rest. All was seen by Janaki and named after them.
Lanka Kand.272: The plane arrived there immediately. Dandaka became where there was great joy. Various sages like Kumbha came. All the sages gathered where Rama went. All the sages were present where Aisika was. Jagaddisa came to Chitrakuta. The sages were satisfied there. The plane landed there and they saw it. Rama and Janaki often saw each other. On the Jamuna banks, they enjoyed themselves. Again, they saw Surasrini Punita. Rama said, bow to Sita. The lord of tirthas again saw Prayaga. Seeing his birth, he felt no sorrow. He saw the most purifying Punini. He enjoyed himself, sorrow left, and the world rejoiced. Again, he saw Ayodhya, extremely purifying. Tribhida tapa bhava roga vanished.
Lanka Kand.273: Salute with gratitude to Rama, whose heart is rekindled with joy at the sight of Sitā in Ayodhya. Again, the Lord came to the tribeni (confluence of three rivers) and made the waters joyful. With monkeys and sages, he distributed various kinds of gifts.

Uttar Kand.1: A throat like a conch, a neck like a full moon, feet like lotus buds, a face adorned with beauty, wearing a yellow garment, born of a wish-fulfilling tree, always happy. Hands like a bow of the ocean, served by friends, Naumi, Janaki, the best among Raghus descendants, Pushpakaruddha Rama. Lotus-like, charming, like a dewdrop on a jasmine, the king of Kosala, a delightful sight to the eyes. Janaki, the one who enchants, like a lotus in a pool, charming to the mind of the contemplative. Kundalindara, fair like cows ghee, beloved of the goddess Ambika, fulfilling all desires. I adore Shankara, whose eyes are like a cluster of lotus buds, captivating like a dance of the gods.
Uttar Kand.2: A day-long intense austerity for the elderly. Everywhere one thinks of the union of man and woman, Rama. Become related, beautiful in all, the heart is pleased in everyone. The Lord makes the people happy, the city delightful to behold. Kausalya and others, the mothers, have joy in everyones heart. The Lord Sri, being pleased, speaks to say now. Bharat with eyes, hands, and feet, twelve in number. Knowing the relatedness, the heart is filled with great joy and considers actions.
Uttar Kand.3: Only one day of the deadline remains. Understanding this, my mind became immensely sad. For what reason has the Lord not come? Perhaps he, the crooked one, has forgotten me. Ah, blessed Lakshman, fortunate one. Devoted to Ram's lotus feet. The Lord recognized me as deceitful and crooked. That's why the Lord did not take me along. If the Lord understands my deeds. I will not be liberated for hundreds of millions of eons. What fault of a devotee does the Lord consider? The friend of the poor is very gentle by nature. My firm hope is this. Ram will meet me, and good omens will appear. If the deadline passes and my life remains. Who in the world is more wretched than me?
Uttar Kand.4: Rams sorrow filled the ocean, his heart was consumed by separation. With a bipru (a type of musical instrument) held, the son of the wind (referring to Lord Krishna) came to see, and the brother (referring to Lord Rama). Sitting, he recited verses with a kusa mat, jata (holy tuft), and crown. Reciting Ram, Ram, Raghupati, his eyes filled with tears.
Uttar Kand.5: Hanuman saw and was extremely delighted. His eyes welled up as he sang. His heart felt immense joy. He spoke, comparing hearing to nectar. He thought of separation and lamented day and night. He constantly sang praises. Raghukul is the kind who brings joy. Kusala, the devotee and sage, protects. Sujit, the brave, sings the glory of the gods. With Seita and his brothers, the lord arrives. Hearing this, lifes sorrows are forgotten. Like one who drinks ambrosia, thirst is quenched. Where are you, my dear brother? I will tell you about the supreme beloved. I am the son of Vayu, Hanuman. Your name is my refuge, O merciful one. I am the servant of Raghupati. Hearing this, Bharata stood up respectfully. Love does not fit in the heart. Eyes weep with joy, pulsating with delight. Seeing you
Uttar Kand.6: As Nij Das when reciting the verses of Raghuvansabhuvan, Bharat Bhanu Binayak was extremely delighted and danced with joy. Raghuvir praising his own face, sang that if God were in the world. Why not Binayak be the supreme pure one with eternal virtues.
Uttar Kand.7: Rama is dear to my heart, thou art truth and the preserver. Again and again meeting Bharat, my heart does not get satisfied hearing about it. Bharat does not bow his head even a little, the monkey Rama went ahead. Saying all this to Kusala, Bharat became happy and climbed the Lord.
Uttar Kand.8: Harsi brought news to Bharat of Kosalapur. He narrated all the news to everyone. Again, he talked about the temple matters. The news of Kusal and Raghuraj reached the city. Hearing the news, all women stood up. The Lord explained Kusal and Bharat. The news reached the easterners. Men and women were delighted. Milk, barley, and fruits were gathered. New tulsi leaves brought joy. Hemadhara and Bhagini sang. They moved like the waves of the river. Children and elders moved together. Each one understood their place. You saw the merciful Raghuraj. The Lord came to Avadh. He was the gathering of all beauties. He was like Suhabhira, a mixture of three scents. He was like Saraja, extremely pure water.
Uttar Kand.9: Happy friends gathered with Gur, disciple Bhushur, and Brint. They went to Bharat, their hearts filled with love and the most beautiful grace. They climbed the stairs of Atarin and saw the sky like an airplane. Seeing it, they were delighted by the sweet melody of Sumangals song. King Raka, with the moon and Raghupati, saw the sea of Sindhu and was delighted. They made a commotion like waves of men and women.
Uttar Kand.10: Here is Bhanku Kamal Divakar. The city that appears to be a monkey is charming. Listen to the monkey Angad of Lanka. The holy city is beautiful and colorful. Even if everything is heaven, it is the ancient world that is known. Avadh city is not dear to me at all. This is a topic known by someone. My birthplace is the dear city. Uttar can be seen, many Sarju rivers flow. Go, I will not make any effort without you. I am very dear here. My abode city is a place of happiness. Everyone hears the Lords words, rejoicing. Blessed Avadh, which speaks of Rama.
Uttar Kand.11: Seeing the flood, people prayed to Lord Kripasindhu. The city near, the Lord encouraged and rose above the ground. Rising, the Lord said to Pushpak, You go to Kubera. Encouraged Ram went, very happy.
Uttar Kand.12: Come, let all gather in the hall of Bharat. Bow to Lord Raghuvir with body and soul. Bāmdev, Basistha, the great sages. Seeing the Lord, men hold bows and arrows. Holding the teachers words in heart, the body blossoms with joy. The younger brother, filled with ecstasy, dances with joy. The sage understood the victory; we too understand your victory. All the twice-born gathered to sing. Raghukulnātha, the pillar of dharma. Bharat again bowed to the Lords lotus feet. Bowing to those like sages and gods. Earth did not rise, but the ocean was embraced with kindness. Sylam sang, her cheeks wet with tears. New Rajiv, his eyes filled with tears.
Uttar Kand.13: Rajiv Lochan became a graceful wave of the river Triveni. With intense love, he clung to the heart, meeting his brother Anuj, the wealthy Tri Bhun. Meeting Anuj, I cannot find a comparison, for Janu, love and beauty embraced his body. Understanding the kindness of the treasury, he filled his life with happiness, not finding any beauty in life but happiness. Now knowing the Lord of skill, he offered his life for the sight of the people. Filled with the pain of separation, he embraced the kindness of the treasury, taking it with him.
Uttar Kand.14: Again the Lord is pleased, slaying the enemy in battle; He pierces the hearts with great love. When Lachman met Bharat then the two brothers full of love were united.
Uttar Kand.15: Brother Lachman met again. Removing the pain of separation, he found happiness. Sitas beauty, Bharatas sorrow, and Lakshmans companionship led to supreme bliss. The Lord looked pleased, and all worries vanished. Everyone saw the joy of love. Kindness was everywhere. Infinite and beautiful, kindness was found every moment. Meeting God in the morning, none knew what to say. Thus, Ram made everyone happy. Moving forward, he saw virtues and good qualities. Mother Kausalya and others were there. Seeing children, he gave cows and calves.
Uttar Kand.16: As if cows, leaving their calves at home, went to graze in the forest. At the end of the day, with udders flowing, they mooed and ran. With great love, all mothers met their children and spoke many soft words. Their terrible separation was gone, and they gained immeasurable joy and happiness.
Uttar Kand.17: Tanay Sumitra Ram Charan Rati know. When Ram met Kakeeyaa, his heart beat very fast. Lacchman met all maternal uncles and got happiness. Kakeeyaa again and again met, but the mind did not get satisfied.
Uttar Kand.18: All gathered in joyous assembly. With great delight, they all came together. As soon as he saw Sita, Valmiki began to compose. He became steadfast, your vow unshaken. All looked at Raghupatis face, his lotus-like mouth. Knowing it was auspicious, they held back their tears. They removed the golden throne, one by one they gazed at the Lord. In various ways, they looked on, their hearts filled with supreme bliss. Again and again, Raghubhi (Rama) appeared, Kausalya, like the ocean of mercy, was agitated. Heart by heart, twelve times they considered, like the Lanka king, they were struck. Very youthful, the pair, in my vicinity. Nischar, the handsome and mighty demon.
Uttar Kand.19: Lakshman and Sita with Lord Bilokata Matu. Blissful mind is lost again and again with pulses.
Uttar Kand.20: King Lakshman was Nala of blue hue. Jamvant was Angad with beautiful eyes. Hanuma and all others were valiant bowmen with charming bodies. Bharat was affectionate with a vow of love. All were filled with intense love. How do the city dwellers behave? Everyone praises the Lord with affection for His feet. Again, Raghupati spoke to all his friends. He touched the sages feet and taught everything to all. Guru Basist was our revered ancestor. By their grace, Danu and Rana were destroyed. I heard all this from my sage friend. How can Samar Sagar be compared? They were born for my benefit. Bharat is even more dear to me. Hearing the Lord, everyone became peaceful and joyful. Moment by moment, happiness arose.
Uttar Kand.21: Kausalyas smile reappeared, and she again looked beautiful. Asita was delighted, you are dear to me like Raghunath. The garden was filled with blooming suman flowers, and the houses were like a cluster of happy clouds. She saw the city filled with men and women.
Uttar Kand.22: Golden pots adorned with intricate designs. Early morning adorned with their own unique decorations. Flags flutter on Bhandanavar day. Early morning created auspicious moments. Watered all with the scent of flowers. Created a garden of four corners with jasmine. Various auspicious decorations. Joyous flags fluttered in the city. Everywhere women gathered to celebrate. Filled her heart with joy. Golden altars for Aarti in various ways. Adorning with beautiful songs. Performing Aarti, the essence of Aarti. For Raghukul, Bipin and Dinkar. Grand beauty, wealth, and blessings. Nigam, Seesh, and Saraswati praised. Yet, seeing this story, how can one hide. Uma, how can one praise the man like this.
Uttar Kand.23: Flower Kumudini, Avadh, the seat of Raghupati, is pained by separation. Having ceased to exist, I have become a witness to the pain of Rama, the conqueror of Raksas. Ever-changing, beautiful, and diverse, the sky is adorned with stars. God, the protector of men, women, and children, has moved the universe.
Uttar Kand.24: Lord Janaki was shy. First, they went to Bhavanis house for the card game. Indeed, much joy was given at Bodh Gaya. Again, they went to their own house, where Hari was invited. The ocean of mercy, when they went to the temple, all men and women became happy. Guru Basistha called the twice-born. Today, the beautiful and auspicious day arrived. All the twice-born gave joy and instructions. Rama-chandra sat on the throne. Sage Basistha wished for their safety. Hearing this, all the Bhrigu people greatly enjoyed. They said that Basistha was gentle and many Bhrigus. The world is happy with Rama, and Rama is installed as king. Now, the sage did not delay. Maharaja applied the tilak.
Uttar Kand.25: Then the sage said to Sumitra, as he listened, his joy increased. Many chariots were quickly prepared with numerous horses. Wherever they ran, auspicious omens appeared. Joyful, he settled in his place and then bowed his head.
Uttar Kand.26: Avadhpurī was made extremely fragrant. Devanhn Sumana was sprinkled with dew. Rām called the servants, and the first friend went with them. When the people heard, they came wherever they were. Sugrīva and others immediately came. Karunānīthi was filled with tears. Rām removed his own hair and became clean-shaven. The Lord called three brothers. Bhagat, Bāchhal, and Kṛpāl, Raghurām. Bhāgī, the fortune of the Lord, was gentle. Even a crore of people could not praise Him enough. Again, Rām put on his own hair and became thoughtful. Following the gurus instructions, He bathed. After bathing, the Lord adorned Himself with ornaments. Seeing the unblemished body, He felt ashamed.
Uttar Kand.27: Take her with dignity and marry her immediately. Adorn her body with jewelry and dress her beautifully. Seeing Lord Ram and Bama, Ramas form and virtues are evident. Mother sees all with joy, knowing the fruit of her sons birth. Hear O Khages, that opportunity when Brahma, Siva, and the assembly of sages arrived. Ascending the aerial vehicle, all the gods came to see with joy.
Uttar Kand.28: Lord Biloki, with a heart full of love. Immediately sought the divine throne. Rabis brilliance did not fade, remained as bright as ever. Seated, Lord Rama, the sage had no head covering. Janaks son along with Raghuram gathered. The sage distributed the crowd with enthusiasm. The sage recited Vedas and mantras, the heavens and sages shouted Jaya. First, the tilak was applied to Muni Basistha. Then, all the Bhrigu clan were invited. Bilokis daughter was delighted. Repeating, she performed aratis. The Bhrigu clan gave various donations. The Jatha performed all, the ajatha as well. On the throne, Trilokya Sahay was seen. Sages played the drums.
Uttar Kand.29: The sky resounds with the drums of clouds, and the multitude of Gandharvas and Kinnaras sing. Dances are performed by the Apsaras, filled with supreme bliss, by the sages and deities. Bharata and others, including Anjus, Vibhishana, Angada, and Hanumad, are present together. The canopy, umbrella, and banner flutter with the strength of skin, and the chariots are adorned with wealth. Sri Sahanita Dinkar Bansi Bhooshan performs many acts. The new ambrosial clouds sing, the ambrosial color delights the mind. Various magnificent ornaments are worn on every part of the body. Those with large lotus-like eyes, broad chests, and strong arms can see them.
Uttar Kand.30: He sang not of a palace bringing joy to the people. But he knew the essence of Sāradā, Seṣa, and the Vedas, O Mahes. Different melodies sang different deities in their own abodes. Then came the time when Śrī Rāma became manifest. The Lord, all-potent, is the treasury of grace and respect. I cannot describe anything, nor can anything be compared to the singing of his praises.
Uttar Kand.32: Only the generous beg for forgiveness and penitence. Disappearing, they again return to the home of Brahman. Banateya heard Sunda come to where Raghubir was. Binay, he shook and shuddered, his body filled with ecstasy.
Uttar Kand.33: Victory to Ram, the beloved of Rama. See the people tormented by lifes troubles. Lord of Avadh, Rama, the fearful. Come to
Uttar Kand.34: I pray to Sri Rang again and again, with unwavering devotion and always in the company of truth. With the arrival of Umāpati Rāms virtues, I was filled with joy, reaching Kailās. Then the Lord, the monkey king, brought happiness through all means.
Uttar Kand.35: Listen, Khagpati, this story is sacred. The triple bond of suffering, passion, and fear is fierce. Great King Kar performed a splendid coronation. Hearing it, men become content and wise. Those who listen to this song and sing it, gain happiness, wealth, and various blessings. The sweet and rare joy of God is known throughout the world. At the end of time, Raghupati will return. Listen, become free, wise, and virtuous. Embrace devotion, path, and wealth. Khagpati narrates the story of Rama. Self-will, pleasure, fear, and distress are removed. Cultivate wisdom, devotion, and firmness. The beautiful river of attachment is called. Always in the new city of Kausalya. People remain happy. Always in the love of Ramas lotus feet. All who offer prayers to Shiva and sages. Many forms of beauty are adorned. Brahmins learn the
Uttar Kand.36: All the monkeys were immersed in divine bliss. They did not know the passage of time.
Uttar Kand.37: Lost in dreams of home, reason fails me. Like a traitor saint, my mind rebels. Then Raghupati spoke to all his friends. Come, all of you, with heads bowed down. Seated close to supreme love, he uttered sweet devotion. You have been my most devoted servant. I can do nothing to your face. Father, I find you very dear. For my sake, you gave up worldly happiness. Anjoo, the prince, wealth, and beauty. Body, home, family, all are dear. None are dearer to me than you. I do not call you a foe. Everyone loves their servant this way. But for me, you are more like a devotee.
Uttar Kand.38: Now in home I sing praises of my beloved, my heart is firm in love. Always present and encompassing all, I know supreme love.
Uttar Kand.39: When the Lord heard, all words failed. Where have we lost our bodies. Firmly hold together and move forward. Say or not say, it is supreme love. The Lord saw the utmost affection. He said, using various methods of knowledge. The Lord could not speak in the Lords presence. Again and again, he looked at the lotus. Then the Lord adorned himself. With various colors, he looked beautiful. Sugriva first wore them. Adorning himself, he filled the place with his own hands. The Lord inspired Lacmana to wear them. Rama, the Lord of Lanka and Raghupati, pleased him. Angad sat, did not sway. Seeing affection, the Lord did not speak.
Uttar Kand.40: Jamvant and Neela all dressed up Ragunath. Holding the thighs, assuming the form of Ram, they all came down from the sky. Then Angad stood up, his head drooping with tearful eyes, strongly. Utterly tender, he spoke, filling his heart with the essence of love.
Uttar Kand.41: Listen to the grace that brings joy, O all-pervading. You are the compassionate one, the protector of the poor. When I am lost, you are the guide, the one who gives strength. I am the plaything of your grace, a devotee for your pleasure. You are my lord, my guru, my father, and my mother. Where shall I go, where shall I find my place? You consider, O man and woman. The Lord has no work for me to do. A child is weak in knowledge, wisdom, and strength. Keep me in your shelter, O lord, protect the poor and the needy. I am lowly, what can I do in a house? I am a lotus among the flowers of the world. Saying this, I pray to the Lord, now I call the lord my home.
Uttar Kand.42: Angad heard Bhanvis complaint and Raghupatis sorrow. The Lord lifted his arms and comforted Rajiv with his moist eyes. His own heart filled with love, he adorned himself with a childs attire. When bidding farewell to Bhagavan, he explained in many ways.
Uttar Kand.43: Bharat and Anuj along with Sauti. Chanting, they followed the devoted Bhagats creation. Angad had no trace of hatred in his heart. Again and again, he reminded himself of Ramas side. Repeatedly offering salutations and punishments. His heart said, I cannot remain without Rama. Rama, being seen, spoke and moved. Remember, remember, thinking and smiling, meeting. The Lord, seeing the statue, spoke much. Bharat came with his brothers, Hiranay. Sugriva met Raghupati in various ways. Like Binyay, Hanuman did so. Serving for ten days, Raghupati. Again, I saw your meeting, Deva. You are the son of Vayu, full of merit. Please serve and accept my plea. Saying this, the monkeys went immediately. Angad said to Hanuman, listen.
Uttar Kand.44: I prostrate before the Lord and say, let me speak with great force. Time and again, Lord Raghunath made Surati do for me. Then Balisut went away, and Hanuman came back. The Lord, pleased with him, said that he had become humble. I desire a harsh Kulis, yet I desire a very delicate flower. My mind, O Rama, having understood, says something.
Uttar Kand.45: Again, Kripali spoke to the Nishada. Adorned with jewelry, he was blessed by Prasada. I will remember my home, my thoughts will be of my departure. My mind will follow the path of duty and righteousness. You are my friend, like Bharata to Lord Rama. You will always stay, coming to my home. Hearing my words, the listener felt great joy. His eyes filled with tears as he spoke. Carrying the flower of his youth, he entered the house. The Lord, with his beautiful form, spoke to his devotees. Raghus descendant, seeing the deeds of Raghupati, again and again said, Blessed are those who are happy. Rama the king sat in all three worlds. Overjoyed, he left all sorrow. He did not do anything for anyone at any time. Rama the val
Uttar Kand.46: People, devoted to their own duties of Varna and Ashrama, following the path of the Vedas. Always walked happily, without fear, sorrow, or disease.
Uttar Kand.47: Physical divine material heat. Ram Raj is not widespread. All humans cherish mutual love. Walk with dharma constantly listening to shruti and ethics. All four changes are dharma in this world. Fully dream none is incomplete. Ram devotion is in men and women. All are eligible for supreme attainment. No one is short-lived or old. All are beautiful some are sickly. No one is poor, sad, or helpless. All are innocent and wise. All are clever and virtuous. All are wise and knowledgeable. All are grateful none is deceitful.
Uttar Kand.48: Ram Raj was such that the whole world praised it. Good karma, natural virtues, merits, and no suffering at all.
Uttar Kand.49: The earth girdled by seven seas. One earth for King Raghupati Kosala. Bhunekh goes to Rome. This power is not much to boast. So, one understands greatness from the Lord. This is said to be humility by many. So, greatness is known by the eyes that see. Then, this history is believed to be true. So, knowing and experiencing is this play. The great sage Damasil says. Rama rules, happiness, and wealth. Born, he could not be the Saraswati. Everyone is generous, everyone is helpful. Brahmins perform service, men and women. One woman takes a vow for all. And her mind, in order, benefits her husband.
Uttar Kand.50: Punishment separates where the actor dances in society. Victory within oneself hearing is Ramachandras reign.
Uttar Kand.51: Flowers and fruits forever in the forest of trees. Remaining as one in a group of five. Birds and animals live naturally forgetting fear. All increase mutual affection. Birds and animals form various herds. Fearless, they become blissful. Cool and fragrant, the wind blows gently. Murmuring Ali, they move to Makarand. Twining vines gather honey, cows give milk to the heart. Ever adorned with flowers, the earth remains. Becoming the Kritayuga from the Tretayuga. Various delights are found in the mountains. The earth, the mother of the world, is known. Rivers flow again and again. Cool, sweet, and pleasant, they bring happiness. The sea remains with its own waves. Sparkling with gems, the shore is filled with people. The confluence of rivers is crowded with all. Extremely happy, ten directions are divided.
Uttar Kand.52: The sun's rays, which previously scorched the earth, now for the same purpose. Begged for water from the clouds in Ramachandra's reign.
Uttar Kand.53: The Lord performed millions of Ashwamedha sacrifices. Gave many donations to Brahmins. Protector of the path of Shruti, upholder of Dharma. Beyond qualities, and enjoyer of pleasures. Sita always remained devoted to her husband. A mine of beauty, well-behaved, and humble. Knowing the Lord's supremacy, the ocean of mercy. She served his lotus feet with her mind. Although there were many servants and maids in the house. Always skilled in various ways of service. She performed household chores with her own hands. She followed Ramachandra's commands. In whatever way the ocean of mercy found happiness. She knew that method of service.
Uttar Kand.54: Please forgive the broken bowstring, for I long to hear. Rams footprints bring love and a pleasant heart.
Uttar Kand.55: Serve with a pleasant heart, all brothers. Ram Charan is extremely beloved. Lords face like a lotus always looks. Sometimes shows mercy to us. Ram feels affection for his brother. Teaches ethics in various ways. Residents of the city remain happy. Performs all rare music and enjoyment. Meditates according to the will. Longs for the divine activities of Sri Raghuvir. Two beautiful daughters Seeta go. Lava sings ancient Kus and Bed. Two temples without pillars, the image of Hari is extremely beautiful. Two sons are brothers. Became form, merit, and dark.
Uttar Kand.56: He who is beyond knowledge, speech, senses, unborn, beyond Maya, mind, and qualities. That very embodiment of truth, consciousness, and bliss performed noble human deeds.
Uttar Kand.57: Morning worship and meditation. Sit in assembly with virtuous sages. Recite ancient Vedas and know all, even if it is Ram. Brothers Anuj and Sanjut take their meal together. All women are filled with joy. Bharat and his enemy brother met with Pavans son. Sitting, Ram sang praises. Hanuman spoke wisely. Listening to the pure praises, one finds immense joy. Again and again, one speaks with humility. All homes are old. Ramcharitmanas is blessed in various ways. Men and women sing the praises of Ram. Day and night, they do not know when to stop.
Uttar Kand.58: The society of happiness and wealth of the residents of Ayodhya. Even a thousand Sheshas cannot describe where King Ram reigns.
Uttar Kand.59: Narada and other sages, Sanaka and others. Coming for a vision, the king of Kosala. Visiting the city, he forgot its beauty. Created in the form of a dream, beautiful garlands. The city, all its parts, extremely beautiful. Created with various colors, like a kangura. New planets created in a unique way. Surrounding Janu, Amravati came to life. Many colored glass created, which made the sages dance. White abode, touching the sky, the clouds praising the lord. Many sages created, shining brightly, each house with a lamp.
Uttar Kand.60: The palace shone with jeweled lamps, its walls adorned with coral. Jeweled pillars, created by Brahma, studded with gold, gems, and emeralds. Beautiful and enchanting temples, their courtyards made of radiant crystal. Each door had golden panels, studded with many diamonds.
Uttar Kand.61: Charu Chitrasala wrote a household prayer. Ram Charit which the sage saw, he recited in his mind.
Uttar Kand.62: Sumana wore a cotton garment in the morning. She made various kinds of offerings. Latā loved the beautiful multicolored flowers. Flowers bloom forever, like the lineage. The humming bees face is charmingly resounding. The ever-beautiful Marutribheda flows in various ways. Different birds come and sing sweetly. The peacock, swan, and herons are seen on the banks. Children read and recite the story of Rāma, the protector of the people. The kings gate is adorned in all kinds of beauty. The bazaar is filled with colorful and fragrant goods.
