Bipins government had a special affection. Surasari moved to settle in Prayag. Valmiki the lord was happy to meet. Like Shiva, he lived in Chitrakoot. The king and his ministers died in the city. Bharatas love flowed much. Easterners performed actions with the king. Bharata went where the lord was happy. Again, Raghupati understood many ways. He came to Ayodhya with his sandals. Bharata stayed as the lord of the gods, his son. The lord and Vashishta met again.
Uttar Kand.139: The way the old vulture Sarbhang gave up his body. Then the pure love of Prabhu Agasti's good company was described.
Uttar Kand.140: Tell Dandak to be gentle. Gidh recited friendship again. Again the Lord built Panchavati. Bhanji caused all sages to be afraid. Again Lachman taught the incomparable. Sumanaka was like all ugly people. Khar Dooshan boasted again. Like all being dead, Dasanan knew. Duryodhana killed Maricha anywhere. As it happened, so it was said. Again Maya took Sita to be destroyed. Sri Raghuvira did not express sorrow. Again the Lord did Gidh as it was done. Often Raghuvira bore with patience. Often Raghuvira expressed sorrow due to separation.
Uttar Kand.141: Lord Narada told Maruti to meet Sugriva, the friend. Again, the Lord applied tilak with his own sweat and told Bali to break the life. The monkey applied tilak and the Lord touched the earth with his palms, telling the monkeys to be afraid of Ramas anger.
Uttar Kand.142: Thus the monkey king sent messengers. Searching for Sita, he scanned all lands. Like a wanderer, the monkeys went as they pleased. The monkey found Sita, and they met joyfully. Samirakumar heard the story; fear entered his heart, boundless and deep. The journey to Lanka, as the monkeys did. Again, Sita was patient as ever. Ravana, awakened in anger, bound many. When the monkey came to Raghus realm. Bidehi and Kusalas story was told. With his army, Raghubiра entered. He left, crossing the barinas isle. Vibhishana met them, as he came. The story of the seas subjugation was told.
Uttar Kand.143: The monkey army crossed the sea like a bridge, and the brave hero carried the girls on his back. The night-flier took on various forms, and Kumbhakarna roared with great strength.
Uttar Kand.144: Night and day, the ways of death are many. Raghupati praised Ravana in battle. Ravana was sad over Mandodari. Raja Vibheeshana was without sorrow. Seeta met Raghupati in a distant place. The gods praised her with great enthusiasm. Again, riding Pushpaka with monkeys. To Ayodhya, the Lord went by grace. As he entered his own city. All the incidents were sung in detail. Oh, Rama, you were crowned in a distant place. The king recited many political strategies. The whole story was narrated by Bhussen. I tell you what I know, Bhavani. Hearing the story of Rama, Khaganaha was moved. Reciting, he expressed his deepest wishes.
Uttar Kand.145: I hear the doubt in the news of the entire Raghu Pati charita. I fear that without your grace, Rams position will be destroyed. I am lost in such great love, tied by the bonds of the Lord. I ponder on Chidananada, why did Ram become weak.
Uttar Kand.146: Seeing the story, the great man follows it closely. Fear has heavily burdened my heart, doubt weighs heavily on me. But now I accept this illusion as beneficial. For these are treasures of grace and mercy. He who is extremely eager and anxious becomes like a tree, knowing shade and happiness. If I do not become overly attached, meeting you is as if meeting a relative. Listening to the sweet stories of Hari, you sing in many wonderful and varied ways. Scriptures and ancient beliefs are like this; sages and siddhas have no doubt. Meeting the pure saint, you bring Ramas grace, and through your favor, all doubts vanish.
Uttar Kand.147: Hearing the words of Binay Anurag with Bhangapatis voice, the eyes water and the mind sings with joy. Very sweet indeed. The listener Sumati with good character, relishes the story, Haris devotee. Even Umma is very appropriate, making good people shine.
Uttar Kand.148: Kakabhusundi spoke again. My love for the Lord of the sky (Garuda) is not little. In every way, Lord, you are worshipable to me. You are the recipient of Raghunayak's grace. You have no doubt, no delusion, no Maya. Lord, you have shown kindness to me. Raghupati sent you, O King of Birds, to remove my delusion, and thus honored me. You have told your own delusion, O Lord of birds. That is no wonder, O Gosain. Narada, Shiva, Brahma, Sanaka and others. Those chief sages who are self-realized. Whom did delusion not blind? Who in the world.
Uttar Kand.149: The ascetic Gyani Tapa Suri Kavi Kobid Gun Aagar. None is greedy, none is bewildered in this world. Lord Shri Mad Bakar did not become proud of any power. The eyes do not seem to fit in the face.
Uttar Kand.150: None is a victim of sudden downfall. Some do not believe in madness and do not abandon. Youth is not a fever but a strength. Kindness is a deed but not a show. Mosquitoes do not leave a mark. Some do not lament but sway. Worry does not eat a snake. The world does not engulf one. A worm fulfills its desire with a body not too eager. A child lives for three years. Some do not consider it wise to remain idle. All this is a play of illusion. It cannot be crossed by a powerful endless one. With the face of Shiva and the beauty of Chaturanana, one remains eternal. Others are written by life.
Uttar Kand.151: We remain immersed in the world, full of fierce illusion. The commander, engaged in work and so on, is full of pretense, deceit, and treachery. How can one understand the maid servant of Raghuvir as false? Without mercy, no release; without the Lord, I cannot even utter my position.
Uttar Kand.152: O Maya, everywhere you dance. Though I read the story, I cannot find you. So, Lord, with a smile, Bhrgu Raj. The dance and the dancers, all together in society. So, Sat-chit-ananda, dense Rama. Unchanging forms, power, and strength. All-pervading, all-penetrating, unbroken, infinite. All-powerful, all-effective, Lord. Unbreakable, beyond clouds, beyond time. Ineffable, unbeatable. Formless, without form, without attachment. Ever-blissful, ever-satisfied, ever-happy. Beyond nature, Lord, in all hearts. Brahman, inactive, unmanifest, imperishable. Here, there is no reason for attachment. Lord, face to face with truth, where darkness cannot go.
Uttar Kand.153: For faith, the Lord Rama bears a mortal form, the king Bhagvata. His deeds are pure, the supreme, natural man alike. Just as many forms are donned by actors for dance, they show their feelings, but not as they are.
Uttar Kand.154: Raghupatis play is delightful. Danujis dance brings joy to the people. Those who are skilled in worldly matters with a tarnished intellect. The Lord enthralls with this, making them His own. Where can one say the eyes are at fault. Red or blue, what can be said of the color. When the eyes deceive like Khegasa. Say the west is east, day is night. The world moves like a boat, but the unmovable love stays with you. A child is not deceived by illusion in the house. They say mutual deceit is. The Lords illusion will not deceive me. Not a dream, not ignorance, the situation is. With a weak mind, unfortunate, the heart is entangled in many ways. They doubt and argue, holding their own ignorance on Lord Ram.
Uttar Kand.155: Work anger passion greed attachment sorrow. Yet how can you know King Raghu the fool fallen into the deep well of darkness. Without qualities is easy to understand, but none knows the extremely qualified. Simple yet inaccessible with myriad deeds heard, the sages words confuse the mind.
Uttar Kand.156: Listen, Khagesh Raghupati, the lord of power. I tell you, as per your wish, a pleasant story. Indeed, whoever is bewitched by the lord is so bewitched. I narrate all stories to make them so. O Lord, sing the devotion of Rama, you are our beloved. With the love of Gods virtues, he gives happiness. O Father, there is nothing wrong with you. Sing the enchanting song of the supreme mystery. Listen, Ramas actions are naturally beautiful. People should cherish their own. The root of all virtues is in the world. The reliever of all sorrows cherishes everyone. O Father, remove the distance of kindness. The attachment of the servant to the master is very deep. Like a child, the Gosains body is born. Mother, it is always hard to carry.
Uttar Kand.157: Even at first, pain and crying are experienced by the foolish child. Disease and death are the work of the mother; but she does not harm her child. Timi, Raghupatis own servant Harhin, respects her for her worth. Tulsi Dasa, such a devotee of the Lord, whom can one not praise for renouncing illusion?
Uttar Kand.158: Ramas grace, you have given me health. I sing and hear the story of the mind. When Rama, a human body, took hold. For the devotee, he performed many plays. Then I will see Ayodhya. I will look at the Bala Charit with joy. I will see the birth festival. I will stay five months for greed. Ishtdev, my child Rama, is beautiful. The beauty of Bapas work is countless. My own lord, I see his body. With my eyes, I bring joy to his heart. I carry the Lord with me, Bapas company. I see the colorful Bala Charit.
Uttar Kand.159: Wherever the verses return, there I spread the sound. Wearing a patched garment, I pick it up and eat it. Once Raghuveer performed all the rites very carefully. Recalling the Lord, I relish the play, my body thrilled.
Uttar Kand.160: Said Bhusunda, "Hear, O Khaganayak. Ram's deeds are a servant of joy. The royal palace was beautiful in every way. Inlaid with gold and various kinds of jewels. The charming courtyard, where the four brothers always played, cannot be described. Raghunath performed childish sports. Wandering in the courtyard, he brought joy to his mother. His body was soft like an emerald, dark-complexioned. Every limb had the beauty of many Kamadevas. His new lotus-like feet were reddish and soft. His beautiful toenails stole the luster of the moon. His four charming toes were like ankus (elephant goads). His anklets made sweet sounds. His beautiful waist-belt, made of pure jewels, was charming and melodious."
Uttar Kand.161: The line is beautiful with a pleasant chest, a charming navel. The back is rectangular, broad, adorned with various hairs.
Uttar Kand.163: Come near and laugh, Lord; weep and cry. Go near and sit, again and again, thinking. Seeing the play of the childlike Lord, I am enchanted and charmed. Why does the Lord, Chidānand, compose these characters?
Uttar Kand.164: This mind-attaching is Kagaraya. Raghupati is pervaded by the inspired Maya. So Maya is not sorrowful, I am none. Living beings are like the transient world. Lord, why come here for some reason. Hear, be careful Harijan. Know that entire is One Seeta. Maya resides in beings, constant and variable. When all is One, why say difference. God is the being, who says what difference. Maya resides in beings, proud. God is Maya, praise-worthy. Supreme is the being, self is God. Beings are many, One is Shrikantha. Even if deluded by Maya, in the end, without Hari no way.
Uttar Kand.165: Without Ramachandras bhajans, what is the use of renunciation? Even a wise person is like an animal without a tail. Raka_pat All the mountains are decorated, without day and night.
Uttar Kand.166: Thus, without Hari, how can there be singing by Khagesa. He is not afflicted by lifes troubles. Hari says, he is not deluded by ignorance. The Lord inspires, and he is filled with knowledge. Father, I do not become a devotee by force. Devotion, faith, and devotion—these afflictions are unbearable. Ram was amazed and saw the illusion. Listening from there, he heard the special stories. He played with that joy, not caring about anyone. He knew neither younger brothers nor parents. He knew water, drank it, and became absorbed. He sang in black and red, charming everyone. Then I fled, a wanderer. Ram was deep, how could I reach him. Like flying through the air, I flew far. There, I saw Hari, my own nearness.
Uttar Kand.167: I have flown away while losing consciousness after reaching Brahmalok. With my fingers I pointed at everyone who was Ram, and I was enchanted. Breaking through the sevenfold barrier, wherever I landed, the Lord saw me with His arm and was terrified.
Uttar Kand.168: I stare with my eyes wide when fear strikes. Then I quickly went to Kosalpur. I saw Rama in his beloved place. Immediately I turned my face away. In my chest, I feel like an egg. I see many universes. The people there are very diverse. Their creation is more than one. Thousands of Chaturanan Gauri fly. Infinite are the wings of Rabi and Rajnise. Infinite are the Lokapalas and Jamakala. Infinite are the mountains and the vast earth. The ocean is endless and boundless. Various forms of creation are spread out. Gods, sages, Siddhas, Nagas, humans, and spirits exist in four forms.
Uttar Kand.169: Who has not seen, who has not heard, whose mind has not been revealed? All this I shall see in a new manner, by a wonderful method. Indeed, I remain as one universe for seven days. Seeing it thus, I am then many eggs.
Uttar Kand.170: People see different creators. Different Vishnu, Shiva, and Manu appear before them. Men, Gandharvas, ghosts, Kinnaras, Nischaras, animals, birds, and snakes. Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, and various other species. All living beings are of the same kind. Men and women are born from various rivers and mountains. Each egg has its own form. I see many beautiful forms. Worlds are born from different Avadhipuri. Rivers give birth to different men and women. Dasharatha and Kausalya have children. Various forms of Bharata and his brothers appear. Rama descends in each Brahmanda. I see endless Balbinod.
Uttar Kand.171: Different indeed I see every form of Harishchandra. Infinite universe I see again but not Lord Rama. So be it child of Sinhaphan so be it beauty so be it kindness of Raghuvir. Universe I see again and am inspired and lost in ecstasy.
Uttar Kand.172: I am deluded, thinking the universe is many. I have passed through countless ages, seeing only one eternal. Again and again, I return to my own hermitage. There I stay for some time, living. I hear of my Lords birth and duration. I rely on love, becoming happy. I see birth as a great festival. As I said at first. I see the world in the chest of Rama, various. I see Rama, the wise, as the master of Maya, the merciful Lord. I consider, wandering, wandering. My mind is filled with the delusion of love, the poison of Kali. I have seen both homes, and I see myself in all. I am afraid, my mind is deluded, full of love.
Uttar Kand.173: Seeing Kripa, Raghuvir is moved to tears. His face turns red, and I hear his thoughts slowly. Then he starts reciting the lyrics again, this time Ram. He explains like a crore, but my mind does not find rest.
Uttar Kand.174: Seeing the history, I realize its power. Understanding the body, I forget the servant. I do not speak with my face on the earth. Protect me, protect me, the people protect. The Lord of love, I am enchanted. His own illusion, power is stopped. The Lord holds my head with a lily. Merciful and compassionate, He removes all suffering. O Rama, you are completely charming. The servants happiness, His grace is doubt. Considering power first, I consider. My mind becomes extremely happy. Devotion deceives the Lord, how does He see? This affection in my heart grows especially. My wet eyes are excited. These are many ways of separation.
Uttar Kand.175: Hearing the words of my beloved, Deenij Das smiled. Ramaniwas spoke with joy, seriously and gently. Kakabhunsundis heart was filled with immense joy as he knew the eternal path and released all desires and sorrows.
Uttar Kand.176: Knowledge, discrimination, detachment, and wisdom. Many virtues in the world that are rare for sages. Today, give all without doubt. Ask what your heart desires. Hearing the Lord's words, he became greatly devoted. Then he began to ponder in his mind. The Lord said, "I will give all happiness." He said, "Give me your devotion." Devotion is like all virtues and happiness. Just as many dishes are tasteless without salt. What is the use of happiness without devotion? Thinking thus, the king of birds (Garud) spoke. "If, Lord, you are pleased, grant me a boon. Show me your grace and affection. Ask for the boon your heart desires, Lord. You are generous-hearted and the inner knower."
Uttar Kand.177: Unfading devotion purified your ears, the old song. Which the yogi sage found by grace of the Lord somewhere. Devotion is the tree of wish fulfilled by mercy, the ocean of happiness and home. So I remain entranced by my devotion, may the Lord give me mercy and become Ram.
Uttar Kand.178: Thus spoke the leader of the Raghu dynasty. He said, Speech is the giver of supreme happiness. Listen, Basya, you are naturally peaceful. Why dont you seek this great gift? All pleasures are sought through devotion. None in this world can match its greatness. Those who meditate a billion times do not get tired. Those who chant, meditate, and burn their bodies are not tired. I see your cleverness. I seek devotion, it is very dear to me. Listen, Bihanga, by the grace of the Lord, all good qualities are established in me. Devotion, knowledge, and renunciation are one. The character of meditation is a mystery. I understand all this. My grace is not attained through effort.
Uttar Kand.179: Mayas possible illusion no longer envelops me now. Knowing Brahman, the beginningless, the unchanging, the formless, I am entranced. Entranced by devotion, my beloved, continuously contemplating, listening to the Kaga. What permanence in mind and attachment to a transient state, if I remain steadfast in unchanging affection.
Uttar Kand.180: Now listen to the pure and beautiful speech. Speak simply, truthfully, and with grace. I will preach my own principles. Let my words hold your mind and make you worship me. My Maya is possible in the world. Living beings of various kinds. Everything is dear to me, everything is my creation. I love humans the most. He is a twice-born, a carrier of the Vedic tradition. He is a follower of dharma according to the scriptures. He is dear, excited, and again a knower. He is very dear, a great knower. He is again dear to me, my own servant. He is my only hope, no other is for me. Again and again, I will speak the truth, see me as the most dear servant. Without devotion, how can one be? I love all living beings equally. The devoted are extremely lowly creatures. I am the most dear to my beloved.
Uttar Kand.181: Who would not love a pure, well-behaved, intelligent, and dear servant? The Vedas and Puranas speak of such a policy, listen carefully, O crow.
Uttar Kand.182: A father named Bipul Kumar. Some are separate in nature, some are skilled in crafts. Some are learned, some are ascetics. Some are wealthy, some are donors. Some are all-knowing, some are devoted to dharma. Love for the father is equal in all. Some are devoted to their father, thinking of their welfare in their hearts. Some are aware of their dreams, some are aware of other religions. The son is dear to the father, like life itself. Even if he is like that in appearance, he is different in essence. Thus, living beings, animate and inanimate, exist. Gods, humans, asuras, and all are included. This is my way, I equally give to all. He who renounces passion and illusion, I sing to him, my mind remains free and unbound.
Uttar Kand.183: Man or male, female, being, animate or inanimate. I cherish all feelings, deceit or attraction, my beloved remains. I speak the truth, you are the arrow, my devoted servant, my life and beloved. Without considering this, I cherish you, leaving behind trust in everything.
Uttar Kand.184: Sometimes time does not engulf me. I remember and sing continuously, immersed. Lord, hearing the nectar of your name, I am not unworthy. My body is thrilled, extremely delighted. This happiness, knowing in mind and ears, cannot be tasted by the tongue. Lords beauty, happiness, knowing with eyes, how can words describe it? In many ways, you have made me enlightened with happiness. I am attached to doing, like a child to play. My eyes, like wet eyes, have made the face pale. They are like a picture, extremely hungry in the heart. Seeing them, my heart is agitated, rising. Saying gently, I took the name on my chest. Holding the child, I brought water to drink. Raghupatis life, beautifully singing, I narrate.
Uttar Kand.185: Whoever performs the ritual as prescribed for pleasure will find continuous joy. The men and women of Avadh city find that joy everlastingly. Those who seek transient joy in dreams will not be wicked but noble and wise with divine joy.
Uttar Kand.186: I shall again dwell in Avadh for some time. I see the child Balbinod. I meet Ram Prasad Bhagat at the bazaar. I reach the Lords feet in my own hermitage. Till then I was not deluded by Maya. When Raghunath took me in. I sing these all in secret in the guise of a story. I dance as if bewitched by Hari-Maya. Now I speak from my own experience, Khagesa. Without Hari-bhajan, there is no peace. Without Rams kindness, listen to Khagaras words. I do not know Rams lordship. Without knowing Rams lordship, there is no pariti. Without pariti, there is no love. Without love, there is no devotion. Just as without love, a chicken cannot be cooked in water.
Uttar Kand.187: Without a guru how can one achieve peace and renunciation. Without Bhagat (devotion) to Hari (God), how can one find happiness in songs and ancient Vedas. Without a restful sleep, how can one find natural contentment. Without moving in water, how many efforts will ultimately lead to death.
Uttar Kand.188: Without satisfaction, work is not pleasant. Work is not true happiness or a dream. Without devotion to Ram, desires vanish. Without roots, a tree cannot stand. Without equality, peace does not come. Without a break, the sky cannot be seen. Without faith, religion does not exist. Without fragrance, no one will smell. Without austerity, fire cannot be lit. Without service, wisdom cannot be gained. Without a teacher, knowledge cannot be acquired. Without contentment, the mind cannot be calm. Without another, there can be no comparison. Without belief, there can be no achievement. Without devotion to Hari, fear of the world remains.
Uttar Kand.189: Without faith, there is no salvation; without water, no Ram. Rams grace is necessary; without it, life cannot find rest in dreams. Without consideration, foolish are those who doubt everything. Sing of Ram, the lord of Raghus line, Karunakar, beautiful and blissful.
Uttar Kand.190: I sang with my own intellect, Lord Prataps glory I saw with my own eyes. I speak not of any special skill, for all this I saw with my own vision. Glory, form, and virtues I sang. All infinite, endless, is Ragunath. I sing the virtues of my own, my own sage, my own Hari. No one can cross the path of the sacred texts or reach the end of Siva. You are the original, the seed of all living beings. You cannot fly away, no end can be seen. The glory of Ragupati is understood. No one has ever found a way to measure it. Rama has a beautiful, true body, Durga countless, endless enemies defeated. Sakra has a true, countless, beautiful form. The sky has a true, endless, beautiful space.
Uttar Kand.191: With the immense strength of a hundred million winds, the light of a hundred million suns. The coolness of a hundred million moons, calming all worldly fears. Like a hundred million times, extremely difficult to cross, a formidable fortress. Like a hundred million comets, the unassailable Lord.
Uttar Kand.192: The Lord is deep a thousand crores of truth. Saman is a thousand crores of pure Sris. Tirtha is immeasurable a thousand crores of holy. Name is all pure never contaminated. Himachal is a thousand crores of immutable Raghuvir. Sindhu is a thousand crores of pure profound. Kamadhenu is a thousand crores of equal. All work is done by the Lord. Saraswati is a thousand crores of immeasurable clever. By wisdom a thousand crores of creation skilful. Vishnu is a thousand crores of protector. Rudra is a thousand crores of pure equal destroyer. Dhanvantari is a thousand crores of pure rich. Maya is a thousand crores of universe treasure. The Lord bears a thousand crores of weight. Infinite incomparable Lord of the universe.
Uttar Kand.193: Incomparable is Rama, not a simile can liken him to Rama, says the poet. As countless as the stars that guide the night, Rabi calls the very small great. In this manner, each sage and saint finds their own unique praise for Hari. The Lord, the singer of the hearts longing, is most merciful, and in hearing supreme love, one finds bliss.
Uttar Kand.194: Ram is an ocean of infinite virtues, who can fathom Him? Whatever little I have heard from saints, that I tell you. The Lord, the abode of happiness, the house of compassion, is under the control of existence. Abandon attachment, pride, and ego, and always worship Sita's Lord.
Uttar Kand.195: Hearing Bhusundis plea to survive, Harshita the bird flapped its wings in joy. Eyes filled with tears, the heart was intensely joyful. Sri Raghupatis valor entered the heart. Realizing the trick of desire, one turned back. Recognizing Brahma as the beginning and end of humanity. Again and again, the feathered wings moved. Knowing Rama, love grew further. Without a guru, the path to the worlds treasure is none. Even Brahma and Shiva would be equal. Doubts like a serpent bite, causing sorrowful waves. Your form, Garuda, Raghunayak, I came to you, the giver of happiness. By your grace, my love does not diminish. Ramas mystery is unparalleled.
Uttar Kand.196: That stands varied, pressing without silk. The Garuda spoke, remaining without affection, words of hatred and separation. Lord, I understand Your unyielding nature, I know my Master is You. I humbly say, knowing the ocean of mercy, I am Your devoted servant.
Uttar Kand.197: You are all-pervading, formless and without attributes, transcending everything. Possessing a good heart and virtues, with simple and pure actions. Wise and diligent, residing in wisdom. You are Raghunath's dear servant. Why this body was obtained, I know everything. It bewilders everyone. Rama's biography, the most beautiful master. Wherever, whenever, I cannot leave. Master, I have heard that you are so perfect. Even the great dissolution cannot erase you. I cannot escape God, my heart is in doubt. If in the world, living beings, snakes, humans, gods. Master, you are the creator of all worlds. The egg is cut open, infinite acquisition, the creator. Time is forever heavy, difficult to overcome.
Uttar Kand.198: You are not encompassed by an extremely long time due to whose power. I say that Kindness is knowledge, influence, and strength. Lord, I come to your abode, leaving behind delusion and illusion. Due to whose power, I say that Lord includes all in his affection.
Uttar Kand.199: Hearing this, Garud, the king of birds, rejoiced. Uma spoke with great affection. "Blessed is your intellect, O enemy of snakes. Your questions are very dear to me. Hearing your beautiful questions filled with love. The memory of many births came to me. I have told all my own stories. My child, listen with a respectful mind. Chanting, penance, sacrifice, control of mind and senses, vows, charity. Detachment, discrimination, yoga, and wisdom. The fruit of all is love for Raghupati's feet. Without that, no one attains peace. In this body, I have attained devotion to Ram. Therefore, my attachment to it is great. Whoever has some self-interest in these three, everyone shows affection towards them."
Uttar Kand.200: O enemy of snakes, such a policy, approved by the Vedas, is spoken by good people. One should make friends even with the lowest, knowing it to be one's ultimate benefit. From a silkworm comes beautiful silk. Everyone protects the silkworm, considering it as dear as life, even though it is very impure.
Uttar Kand.201: Selfishness is the snake that kills life. Mind the order to save the position of Ram. Pure so be it, beautiful body so be it. Who gets the body, they worship Raghuvir. Facing away from Ram, take the form as you wish. Poet Kobi cannot tolerate it. Devotion to Ram is here, heart and soul. I am captivated by the supreme beloved. Do not die without your own wish. Without the body, Bhajan cannot be performed. First love much, then become disappointed. Rams face, no happiness ever. Many lives, many actions. Done yoga, japa, tap, makha, dan. Where I have not been in any life. I am a kite, wandering, wandering in the world. Seeing all actions, Gosai, I am not happy now. Wisdom, I am the lord, born many times. By Shivas grace, intellect is not captured.
Uttar Kand.202: Tell me, Bihag, now narrate the events of the first birth. Upon hearing, the Lords feet become the object of devotion, and the sins of the heart are erased. The male cycle is one Lord in one age, the Kali Yuga, from the beginning. Man and woman, adhering to unrighteousness, are contrary to all religious codes.
Uttar Kand.203: He went to Cosulpur in the Kali Yuga. Born as a Shudra, he found his body. Devotee of Shiva, his mind followed a sequence of devotion and speech. Coming to know the devas, he became proud and arrogant. Greed for wealth and passion led him astray. His fierce intellect was filled with pride and shame. Even though he lived in the capital of Raghu, his greatness was not known. Now I know I am the influence of Avadh. I sing the old hymns that have come and gone. Poets have lived in Avadh, born and died. Devoted to Rama, they have become one with him. The influence of Avadh is known when Rama resides in ones heart. So the Kali Yuga is a harsh test. All men and women renounce sin.
Uttar Kand.204: All virtues and holy scriptures have perished in the grass. The proud have revealed many paths by their own intellect. Men have become all deluded, greedy, and evil in actions. Hear O devotees, the knowledge of the Lord says about the evil age.
Uttar Kand.205: There is no Varna dharma nor the four Ashramas. All men and women are engaged in opposing the Vedas. Brahmins sell the Vedas, kings are like commoners. No one follows the discipline of the scriptures. The path is whatever one likes. A Pandit is one who boasts. Whoever engages in false beginnings and hypocrisy. Everyone calls him a saint. He is wise who steals others' wealth. He who acts with hypocrisy is a great ascetic. If one speaks lies and knows mockery. In Kaliyug, he is praised as virtuous. He who is without conduct and abandons the path of the Vedas. In Kaliyug, he is considered wise and detached. He who has long nails and matted hair. He is a famous ascetic in Kaliyug.
Uttar Kand.206: Wear dirty clothes, O foolish ones who eat impure food. Then only the yogi and only the accomplished man will be revered in the Kali Yuga. Only he who considers the four unvirtuous acts as glorious. Only he who attains the state of mind remaining unaltered will be suitable for the Kali Yuga.
Uttar Kand.207: Woman is the root of man, and man is the root of all Gosains. Dancer, actor, and tailor are the offspring. Sudras and twice-born learn the lesson. Meli Janu, take the cudgel. All men are greedy, lustful, and angry. Devotees, Brahmans, Shrutis, and saints are opposed. Praiseworthy is the temple, beautiful is the husband, and the devotee is a renouncer. Worship the woman, the man is unworthy. The beautiful Soubhagynis are without ornaments. The widows adornment is not new. The disciple is like the blind mans writing. Neither heard nor seen. None of the disciples are sorrowful for wealth. The guru is deep, sending them to hell. Mother, father, and child speak. Filled with the belly, so they teach religion.
Uttar Kand.208: Without Brahm Gyan, one cannot say man, woman, or anything else. For greed, the Bania merchant sits and blinds the guru with his eyes. After that, the Shudra becomes a twice-born, we become you, and there is no blame. Knowing Brahm, the Bania sees with his eyes.
Uttar Kand.209: But three deceitful cheats deceive. They cause delusion, harm, and cheat. Truly, the undivided wise man. He transforms the character of the Kali Yuga. He goes and they change him. As he says, he protects the path of truth. In each age, one man. He hears the corrupted Vedic verses. Who is born with good oil, he is a dreamer, a player, a storyteller. Woman is a home, a property, a widow. Her mind changes, becoming a monk. The Brahmin worships him. Both people do not respect each others hands. The Brahmin is indecisive, fickle, and a worker. He is orderly, diligent, strong, and a master. The Shudra performs various austerities, meditations, and vows. Sitting in a banyan tree, he speaks old stories. All men are imagined as pickled
Uttar Kand.210: In Kaliyug, there is Varna Sankar (mixing of castes), and all people break the boundaries. They commit sins, suffer sorrow, fear, disease, grief, and separation. The path of Hari's devotion, approved by the Vedas, endowed with detachment and discrimination. Men do not follow it due to delusion, but imagine many other paths.
Uttar Kand.211: Many a time she tied the knot, but the beloved left her. Austerities made her rich but she never found joy. A wealthy and poor householder, she never knew the joy of the Kali age. A virtuous woman, she was born as a daughter. She entered her home in sorrow, her life ended in grief. Her son honored her parents, but I cannot see her beautiful face. Her father-in-law and mother-in-law clung to her, but her family became a ruined household. The king did not follow dharma, punishing his subjects without reason. A rich and virtuous family became poor and degraded, the twice-born marked with the mark of a Brahmin became a sinner. One cannot accept the old books, only the devotees and saints are true in the Kali age. The poet is generous and broad-minded, not listening to the world. Praises and curses are mixed, but the praises are more. The Kali age is twelve times
Uttar Kand.212: Hear O Kages, darkness of deceit, violence, pride, enmity, and hatred. The world is filled with pride, attachment, and other passions. Man follows the dark dharma; chanting, penance, vows, and charity are in vain. The gods do not shower blessings on the earth, and crops do not grow.
Uttar Kand.213: Weak women, with many ornaments, are very hungry. The poor are unhappy, their minds are diverse. Fools desire happiness but are not devoted to dharma. Their intellect is small, harsh, and lacks tenderness. Men are afflicted by disease, not enjoying anything. Pride and opposition without reason. Short life, fifteen years. Such is the destruction at the end of the Kalpa. Kaliyug has made humans miserable. No one respects younger siblings or children. There is no contentment, no consideration, no coolness. All castes and low castes have become beggars. Envy, harshness.
Uttar Kand.214: Listen O Balali, in the dark age I am your defect. But O good one, without effort you cannot overcome the age of calamity. In the age of Krita, Treta, Dvapara, worship, meditation. As their nature is, so the age of Kali, the people will glorify the name of Hari.
Uttar Kand.215: All yogis have vanished in the Krita age, meditating on Hari as the only living being. In the Treta age, humans performed various yogic practices. Offer your actions to the Lord, considering the world as transient. In the Dvapara age, Raghupati was worshipped, and humans considered no other means. In the Kali age, only the virtues of Hari are sung. Singing these, humans can attain the world. In the Kali age, no yoga or meditation is performed; just singing the base of virtues. Trust only in those who worship Rama; singing with love, the village prospers. There is no doubt in this; the name is glorious in the Kali age. Make the Kali age anew with a glorious spirit; let the mind be pure, not sinful.
Uttar Kand.216: Equal is the present age, O man, there is no hope, no faith, no effort. Sing the glory of Ram, pure is life, without any effort. Four steps of the chariot of Dharma stand in the age of Kali, giving charity brings welfare.
Uttar Kand.217: The eternal dharma should be for all to follow. Hearts inspired by Rama alone. Purity, equality, and peace have been established. The effect of actions brings contentment to the mind. Sattva is much, rajas a little, and tamas very little in karma. All ways lead to happiness in the Kali Yuga. Rajas is much, sattva a little, and tamas very little in the Dvapara Yuga. Tamas is much, rajas a little, and sattva very little in the Kali Yuga. In the Kali Yuga, dharma is not widespread, but Raghupatis devotion is intense. Actors create cunning deceit, but the devoted servant does not engage in deceit.
Uttar Kand.218: The faults and virtues created by Hari's Maya do not go away without Hari's devotion. Worship Ram, abandoning all desires, thinking thus in your mind. In that Kaliyug, for many years, I lived in Ayodhya, O king of birds. When famine and calamity struck, I went abroad.
Uttar Kand.219: I have become a beggar, hearing the roar of the tiger. Poor, weak, and suffering. I have come, finding some wealth in time. Again, I serve as a devotee of Sambhu. A Bhritya worships Siva, always doing that work without any other. A supreme saint, a supreme penance, a dot of Sambhu. A devotee of Sambhu, not a derider of Hari. I serve with deceit. A Dvija, merciful, with the highest conduct. I appear humble, seeing beyond. A Bhritya has no Brahmin son. Sambhus mantras have made me a humble Brahmin. Good instructions, various ways, have been given. I go to the mantra, Sivas temple for japa. Pride in the heart, I am is more.
Uttar Kand.220: I am a mixture of impurities, low-minded, and a degraded caste. I am a sinner, and the devotees of Hari and Vishnu see me as a sinner and an enemy. I always remain under the influence of delusion, and observing pain, I behave accordingly. My nature is extremely angry and deceitful, and my conduct is based on such feelings.
Uttar Kand.221: Once the guru spoke. He taught me many ways of conduct. Serving Shiv, I enjoyed the fruits of my labor. Devotion to Ram now fills my heart. O father, sing the praises of Shiv, the protector. What can a mere man say? Following the path of devotion, I find joy. O father, the love for Shiv is without end. But without devotion, one is unhappy. Always serving Hari, the guru speaks. Hearing the words of Khenanath, my heart burns. Born in a low caste, I gained knowledge. Like a calf drinking milk, I fear nothing. Trusting in the guru, I fear no trickery. The guru, very merciful, teaches me without anger. Again and again, he guides me to wisdom. When one sees their lowliness, they are first humbled. Like smoke and fire, they are first seen. Then like a dense forest, they are seen. The guru, like the wind, first fills them.
Uttar Kand.222: Once each temple chants the name of Siva constantly. Gurus honor cannot be erased by prostrations. O Mahes, it is not possible to bear excessive insult even if it is from the guru.
Uttar Kand.223: The temple is my abode, the sky my language. O fortunate, proud soul. Even if your guru is not angry, immense compassion and proper understanding. Even if a snake is fierce, I remain not enticed. I do not follow policies in conflict, nor am I deluded by the path of scriptures. If I do not bear punishment, I will fall into the path of deceit. If I am not sincere to the guru, I will suffer in the hell of Raurava. Traversing the three worlds again with a new body, enduring countless lifetimes as a sage. Sitting like a sinner, a snake has entangled my mind. Falling into the deepest abyss, remaining in the lowest depths.
Uttar Kand.224: The sound of the laughter of the cobra, harsh and terrible, I saw Siva. My heart trembled and I felt intense sorrow. Bowing in punishment, with deep love, the twice-born Siva placed his hands on Sivas face. Bowing again, with a trembling voice, understanding the severity, I proceeded.
Uttar Kand.225: I bow to the form of Vishnu, the pervading Brahman, the self-existent, formless, attributeless, without beginning, middle, or end, the consciousness, the space, the abode of knowledge, beyond the reach of words, the formless, the soundless, the fourth state, the lord beyond speech, the fierce, the great, the compassionate, the abode of qualities, the beyond of the world, the lord of devotees, like an ice mountain
Uttar Kand.226: This Rudra Ashtakam was recited by a priest for Harotasya. Men recite it with devotion, and Shambhu dwells in them.
Uttar Kand.227: Hearing the plea, Sarvgya Siva with compassion looked at Brihpr. Again, the dwijbar bar asked the temple to be the Nabhavani. O pleased Lord, I am a servant of the Lord, a poor and wretched one. Give me your devotion on your own feet, O Lord, and again another body. But Maya stays in life, attached and constantly causing forgetfulness. Therefore, do not be angry with the Lord, for his mercy is like the ocean, Bhagavan. Sankar, the merciful, is now this one, be merciful. The snake receives grace where the Lord is.
Uttar Kand.228: This deed brings supreme welfare. Thus, I beg for your grace now. Bhrigus daughter heard the supreme truth. Thus, it became so with the clouds. Even if these are extremely sinful. I again bear the anger and curse them. Yet, I saw your saintliness. I will beg for this special grace. Those who are helpful in welfare. I consider the twice-born as dear like them. My anger towards the twice-born will not arise. I will surely understand this in my next birth. People die in great suffering. This is not a little thing. No one knows when they will be born. I heard that a Sudra was saved by the saint. When Raghupati was born in Ayodhya, then he again took my service with kindness. Ayodhyas influence and grace are mine. The devotion to Ram bears fruit in my heart. Listen, my salvation is true now. The Hari Toṣan vow of serving the Brāhmaṇas
Uttar Kand.229: Hearing the words of Siva, Bhara became joyful and thus spoke: I was awakened and left the house, keeping Sambhus form in my heart. Then, inspired at the right time, I went to the mountain, afraid of the bear. Without effort, I took on that body for some time. I took and left that body easily, as if putting on a new cloth and taking off an old one. I kept Siva in my heart and did not find any fault. In this way, I took many bodies and became Kheisa.
Uttar Kand.230: Whatever body a god, human, or any being takes. They follow Ram's devotion. One sorrow I cannot forget. The gentle and virtuous nature of my Guru. I obtained the body of a Brahmin, which is rare for gods, as sung by the Puranas and Vedas. I played there with children. I performed all the pastimes of Raghunayak. When I grew up, my father taught me. I did not like to understand, listen, or contemplate. All desires fled from my mind. My mind became attached to Ram's feet. Who is such an unfortunate one, O Kagesh? Who abandons the service of Suradhenu (celestial cow)? Immersed in love, nothing pleased me. I abandoned my father's teachings.
Uttar Kand.231: Ramas face turned pale as he remembered Gurus saving grace. When Raghupati used to sing, I felt a renewed affection. The sage Lomasa, seated on the peak of Meru, cast his shadow. Seeing Charan, he bowed his head, deeply moved by the request for salvation. Hearing my plea for salvation, gentle sage Kripa, with a mild demeanor, appeared. I became humble and asked, as a twice-born, what task I could do. Then I said to the benefactor, you are all-knowing and all-powerful. I say you are the Lord Brahma.
Uttar Kand.232: Then Muni Munish sang a song praising Raghupati's virtues. He said, "Chhuk Sadar Kaxganath." The sage, immersed in the bliss of Brahman, realized the supreme master. I longed to learn the teachings of Brahman, the heart of the unborn, non-dual, attributeless. Timeless, desireless, nameless, formless. Attainable by experience, indivisible, incomparable. Beyond the mind, pure, indestructible. Without attributes, boundless, the essence of happiness. There is no difference between that (Brahman) and you. The Vedas sing of it like water and its waves. The sage explained to me in various ways. The attributeless doctrine did not appeal to my heart. Again, I bowed my head at someone's feet. "Tell me, O great sage, about Sagun Upasana (worship of the Lord with attributes)." My mind is like a fish in the water of Ram's devotion. How can it separate?
Uttar Kand.233: Recurring temptation the monk undergoes for discernment of knowledge. I settle my mind then make various conjectures. Without dualistic intellect, anger, without ignorance. Mayas veil broken, dead matters life essence equal.
Uttar Kand.234: Sometimes pain brings gain. Thus poverty drives one to seek wealth. The faithless may become fearless. The diligent again become simple. The twice-born dwell as outcasts. Beings become their true forms through actions. Some wise ones join the foolish. They find a good path by following the virtuous. Beyond the world is the Supreme Soul. Be happy by praising the Lord. Live by principles without knowing. Sing the glories of the Lord without understanding. Pious deeds come without merit. Without sin, no deed is pure. Some benefit through devotion to the Lord. As the ancient sages sang. All is equal in this world. Without meeting Rama, a man cannot know his body. Sin is like a fool. Kindness is the Lords work. Infinite are the ways to understand the mind. The sages advice is not understood. Again and again I
Uttar Kand.235: I tremble with fear, yet I remember Rama and Raghus lineage, my heart filled with joy. Uma, as Rama engaged in his pastimes, lost herself in love, madness, and passion. Seeing her Lord in every form, the world somehow found no conflict with Him.
Uttar Kand.236: Khegesha did not see any sage Dushan. His heart was inspired by Raghunabha, the ornament. Muni Kripasindhu, with wisdom, saw the dawn. I felt the longing for love. My mind, with a measure, knew my own people. The sage again turned to Bhagavan with wisdom. The sage saw my great virtue. The path of Rama was unique in faith. Very fortunate, again and again, I heard. The humble sage spoke to me. I rejoiced with various ways. Happy with the Rama mantra, then I spoke. I focused on the child form of Rama. The sage, moved by kindness, spoke. Very beautiful and blissful, I felt intense emotion. I first told you this to you. The sage stayed for a moment. Then he spoke the Ramcharitmanas. The sage, moved, narrated this story. The Ramcharit is
Uttar Kand.237: Always may Ram be dear to you, you are the embodiment of good qualities and virtue. Kamrup is the wish-fulfilling tree of knowledge, renunciation, and treasure. Whosoever resides in the ashram, may they be remembered again as Sri Bhagavant. Encompass them not with ignorance, let one pure soul be there.
Uttar Kand.238: Time work quality fault good. No pain you shall not be covered. Ram mystery beautiful manner various. Hidden revealed ancient history. Without effort you know all to be false. Always new Ram position to be. Wish what mind desires. Gods grace not rare at all. Muni wisdom hear wise. Brahmapuri becomes serious. Thus be your mind muni knowledge. This is my devotion work mind words. Hearing Brahmapuri joy becomes. Love all doubts gone. With humility muni came finding. Lotus feet again and again on head. With joy here I came to ashram. Gods grace rare found. Here I stay hear Khusa. Seven and twenty years passed. Always sing Raghus praise. Respectfully listen Bihang wise. When Ayodhya city. Raghubir mind body devotee. Then go to Ram city stay. Childlike play see happiness. Again keep Ram childlike form. My own ashram came Khusa Bhup. I tell
Uttar Kand.239: Father, this body is dear to me, an abode of love, the abode of Rama. I have seen the vision of my own Lord, all doubts have vanished. With devotion, I have subdued force, the great sage serpent. I have seen the rare munis, beheld the majesty of devotion.
Uttar Kand.240: Who fears devotion and knows it. Only works for knowledge. They abandon the steadfast cow of wealth. Searching, they find milk. Listen, Kyesha, Hari abandoned devotion. Who wants happiness, attains it. They abandon the steadfast Mahasindhu. Hoping to cross, they seek a boat. Hearing Bhunsundi, the goddess of life, Garuda speaks gently. Then, by the Lords grace, I am in my heart. Doubt, sorrow, illusion, none remain. Hearing the pure Rams virtues, I seek your kindness for rest. One thing, Lord, I ask of you. Tell me how to remove devotions kindness. Saints, sages, and ancient Vedas say. Nothing is like rare knowledge. Hearing, Gosain says to Muni. No respect for devotions path. Devotion and knowledge are different. Both are the Lords grace. Hearing, I believe in
Uttar Kand.241: Only a renunciate man can be a chaste woman with a calm mind and patience. Not a lover attached to worldly affairs, one who is detached from the position of Raghuvir. It is the sage, the repository of knowledge, with eyes like a deer, who sees the face of Hari manifesting as Vishnu and Maya.
Uttar Kand.242: I keep no deceit here. Bed is not for old saints to lie on. Mohini, the enchantress, is beautiful in form. Pannagari, this way, is not perfect. Hear devotion to Bhagat, you both. Women and men know it all. Again, Raghubir, devotion is sweet. Maya, indeed, is a dancer to be considered. Devotion is pleasing to Raghu. Father, that is the fear of very much Maya. Ram, devotion is incomparable, beyond comparison. Stay in it, your heart will always be free from distress. Thus, seeing Maya, she is crushed. I cannot do any of my own lordship. Thus, considering this, the sage understood. Without devotion, one cannot find all happiness.
Uttar Kand.243: This secret none knows except Ragunath. Who knows it, may not be charmed by the grace of Raghupati in dreams. And who learns knowledge and devotion, hearing the distinguished differences. Who hears it, may ever remain attached to the feet of Rama.
Uttar Kand.244: Listen, uncle, this is an unbelievable story. It cannot be understood or believed. God is eternal, life is immortal. Consciousness is the essence of happiness. So, Mayas fear and Gosains bond with death. The knot of consciousness has gone around the root. Even if it is false, it is hard to escape. Then, the soul becomes a world of fear. The knot does not loosen, nor does happiness come. The ancient scriptures speak much about the way. Even more, it cannot be fully explained. The heart is deeply entangled in darkness and illusion. Even if the knot is loosened, it is not seen. This sorrow is when God does it. Perhaps one day it will be without sorrow. Devout faith is like a cow, loved. When Gods grace enters the heart. Japa, tap, brata, jama, innumerable rules. As the scriptures say, a good religion and conduct. Then, the green one sings when
Uttar Kand.245: By practicing meditation, the true nature of action becomes clear. With wisdom as the guide, meditation as ghee, and selflessness as the flame, one should proceed. Then, the wisdom transformed into meditation, filled with compassion, establishes firm equanimity. These three states, these three qualities, are like cotton. Weighed in the balance of the fourth, the discussion becomes profound. In this way, the lamp of wisdom shines brightly. It is always close at hand, even in times of need.
Uttar Kand.246: I am He, thus the verse unbroken. Like a lamp, a wick, the supreme fierce. The experience of the soul, a clear joy. Then, the worlds root, distinctions, and delusions vanish. Strong ignorance, a family, disappears infinitely. Then, the mind attains a stable state. Sitting in the heart, the bond is dissolved. Pulling the heart, then the life is meaningful. Knowing the heart, the bird flies away. Many obstacles are overcome then. Many achievements and inspirations come. Buddha shows greed and deception. Power, trickery, and proximity come. Then, the bond is broken, and the lamp is understood. The mind becomes the supreme tranquility. The body and mind are not incomplete. Then, the mind is not obstructed. Singing the higher self, the lamp is lit
Uttar Kand.247: Then indeed in the course of evolution, the variety of life is vast. The Lords Maya is extremely deceitful, nor can one escape it. Saying it is difficult to understand, difficult to practice, difficult to discern. It whirls one around, justice again a myriad reflections.
Uttar Kand.248: Stream of Grace of Gyana Path. Not even a single layer of veil remains. Only the path without obstacles leads to liberation. Only such a path attains the supreme position of liberation. Liberation, the most rarefied position, is a change in ancient and new scriptures. Worshipping Ram, the Gosai attains the crown. Unwelcome, it comes, the burden. As without earth, water cannot exist, so without such effort, no one can do it. And like the fish cannot exist without water, so cannot remain without divine devotion. Considering divine devotion, a thousand efforts are made. Disregarding liberation, devotion to God is coveted. Without effort and endeavor in devotion, liberation is not attained. Eating to satisfy hunger, it feels good. As without food, the stomach cannot be satisfied, so without such devotion, no one can be satisfied. Such devotion to Hari is simple and blissful. Who is foolish, does not understand this.
Uttar Kand.249: Without the spirit of service, the world does not move. Sing of Lord Rams feet, contemplating the essence of truth. Where consciousness takes root, let it grow into awareness. Sing to Lord Raghunath, and all living beings shall be blessed.
Uttar Kand.250: I say that the doctrine of karma has been dispelled. Hear, devotion is the lord of the heart. Ram devotion, Chintamani, is beautiful. Just sit, Garuda, and go, your heart will be within. The supreme light is the form of day and night. Nothing can be added to the sweet words. Attachment, poverty
Uttar Kand.251: Brahman is the ocean, knowledge is the Mandar mountain, saints are the gods and serpents. They churn the nectar of stories and extract the sweetness of devotion. With the sword of detachment, kill the enemies of pride, greed, and delusion. He who achieves victory through Hari's devotion, consider this, O king of birds.
Uttar Kand.253: A single anger can kill a strong man; pain is continuous in life, so how can samadhi be achieved. Name, dharma, rituals, penance, knowledge, yoga, japa, and charity. Medicine again cannot cure a million diseases, only Hari can cure.
Uttar Kand.254: All living beings are sick. Sorrow, joy, fear, and love are transient. I sing of some minor ailments. All others I have seen and found rare. Some things are known to be wicked. No one can avoid the suffering of birth.
Uttar Kand.255: Ghee is clarified butter but it is oil. Without the song of Hari, there is no way; this is the established principle. Say humbly, O foolish one, the Lord is not false; consider thus, O wise one, and worship Rama.
Uttar Kand.256: I speak truth to you; otherwise, my words would be meaningless. Men worship Hari; those who transcend beyond are exceedingly good.
Uttar Kand.257: I say, Lord Haris glory is incomparable. Right or wrong, it suits. Scriptures principles are here in my heart. Worship Rama, forget all other tasks. Lord Raghupati, give me nothing else. I am attached to you, not to the world. I love you more than myself. You are not a stranger to me. I am very dear to you, Lord. I ask, Ramas story is very sweet. Suk, Sunak, and others feel it in their hearts. Fellowship with the true is rare in this world. A moments punishment is a hundred times worse. I see Garuda examining my heart. I am the rightful singer of Raghubir. All else is worthless. Lord, you have made this world and all its troubles sweet to me.
Uttar Kand.258: I am grateful, I am very grateful, even though I am utterly poor. I know my people, O Ram, meet the saints, this is the humble meeting. I will not keep in Nathas own language, I have nothing to say. The charitra of Sindhu and Raghunayak, where can I find it.
Uttar Kand.259: Recite the virtues of Rama, O Nana. Again and again, praise the wise Harsha. Singing the glory of the great leader, his unmatched power and sovereignty. Worshipping Siva and Aj, the feet of Raghuraama. My humble prayer, I cannot describe this beauty. Some say the lord of Khages is equal to Raghupati. The sadhak, siddha, and liberated, the poet-kavi, kovid, and renunciate. The yogi, soora, and gyani, the dharmic, learned pandit. Without these, none can be my master. I bow to Rama, I bow, I bow. I have surrendered to you, O Rama, I will continue to bow, unending.
Uttar Kand.260: He who is called life is indeed medicine, the great trident. So the merciful one will always be favorable to him. Hearing Bhusundis words, Rama saw a good way to escape and looked at the place where Garuda was standing. He spoke with love and made Garuda doubt.
Uttar Kand.261: I am a humble poet in your language. Hearing the devotion of Raghubir, the essence of faith is revealed. Ramas verses are new, passion renewed. All the perils born of Maya have gone. Attachment, like a fire, has consumed you. O Lord, why have you given me various joys? I am not one who receives constant benefit. I am a servant at your feet, counted countless times. Complete in love, Rama is affectionate. No one is like you, a great and noble relative. Saint, like a stream of Giri, touching the earth for a purpose. Saint, heart like new milk, no one can describe what he says. My own tears are like new milk. But sorrow, like a stream, is the wisdom of the saint. Life, birth, and fruit are all fear. By your grace, all doubts are gone. Knowing this, I am always a servant. Again and
Uttar Kand.262: Bowing his head at the feet with love and steady mind. Garud then went to Vaikunth, with Raghubir in his heart. Girija, there is no other gain like the company of saints. This happens only by Hari's grace, as sung by the Vedas and Puranas.
Uttar Kand.263: I speak of the pure history. Hearing it, ones life passes by like a flash. The heart is moved to see the tree of life. Its fruit is the love of Lord Rama. Mind and body are purified by this. Hearing this story, the mind is drawn in. The means of pilgrimage are the ocean. Yoga and renunciation are the skills. Various duties, religion, vows, charity, control, meditation, austerity, and renunciation. Compassion for beings, service to the twice-born and gurus. Knowledge, humility, and discernment are enhanced. Wherever the means of devotion and the Vedas are spoken, all actions bear the fruit of devotion to Hari. Thus, I sing of devotion to Raghunath. No one can match the grace of Rama.
Uttar Kand.264: Rare devotion to Hari, even for sages, humans attain without effort. Those who continuously listen to this story with faith.
Uttar Kand.265: He alone is omniscient, he alone is virtuous, he alone is knowledgeable. He alone is adorned on earth, a scholar, a giver. He alone is devoted to righteousness, he alone is the savior of his lineage, whose mind is engrossed in the feet of Ram. He alone is skilled in policy, he alone is supremely wise. He alone knows the principles of the Vedas well. He alone is a poet, a scholar, he alone is brave in battle, who, abandoning deceit, worships Raghubir. Blessed is the land where the Surasari flows. Blessed is the woman who follows her husband's devotion. Blessed is the king who practices justice. Blessed is the Brahmin who does not deviate from his own dharma. Blessed is he whose destiny is blessed. Blessed is the mind ripened by devotion to virtue. Blessed is that moment when there is good company. Blessed is the birth.
Uttar Kand.266: All blessed be Umā, worthy of worship and excellent in virtue. Those who follow Sri Raghuvir are free from sin.
Uttar Kand.267: The story of the wise is like a parable. Yet, I keep the first part secret. Then, with a heart full of affection, I reveal more. It is not harsh or cruel. Those whose minds are drawn to hear the divine pastimes. Do not be greedy, angry, or lustful. Those who do not worship the eternal master. The twice-born do not reveal such things ever. The lord of the gods becomes the king. The story of Rama is the most rightful. Those who have the greatest affection for the sat sang. The disciple devoted to the gurus feet. The twice-born servant is the most rightful. Thus, this is a special source of joy. O beloved of Raghupati.
Uttar Kand.268: Whoever desires devotion to Ram's feet or the state of liberation, he, along with his family, should drink this story with his ears.
Uttar Kand.269: O Girija, I have described the story of Ram. It suppresses the impurities of Kali Yuga and removes mental defilements. It is the life-giving root for the disease of transmigration. The Vedas and sages sing the story of Ram. In this, there are seven beautiful steps, which are the path to devotion for Raghupati. Upon whom there is great grace of Hari, he alone sets foot on this path. Humans attain the fulfillment of their desires who sing this story abandoning deceit. Those who listen to the story and approve it, they cross the ocean of existence as easily as a cow's hoofprint. Having heard all the story, it greatly pleased her heart. Girija spoke with pleasant words, "O Lord, by your grace, my doubts are gone, and new love for Ram's feet has arisen."
Uttar Kand.270: I am now a devotee. Only the grace of Bisvesvar has borne fruit. Firm is my devotion, time has passed, all sorrows are gone.
